passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,好拉山德;為了我,親愛的,躺遠一點,別躺這麼近。

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: O take the sense, sweet, of my innocence!
passages.vernacular: 啊,親愛嘅,請領會我純真嘅意思!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,親愛的,請領會我純真的意思!

passages.original: Love takes the meaning in love’s conference.
passages.vernacular: 愛情喺愛嘅交談中領會意思。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 愛情在愛的交談中領會意思。

passages.original: I mean that my heart unto yours is knit, So that but one heart we can make of it:
passages.vernacular: 我係講我嘅心同你嘅心相結,所以我哋只能合成一顆心:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我是說我的心與你的心相結,所以我們只能合成一顆心:

passages.original: Two bosoms interchainèd with an oath, So then two bosoms and a single troth.
passages.vernacular: 兩個胸膛被誓言鎖喺一起,所以係兩個胸膛一份誓約。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 兩個胸膛被誓言鎖在一起,所以是兩個胸膛一份誓約。

passages.original: Then by your side no bed-room me deny; For lying so, Hermia, I do not lie.
passages.vernacular: 嗰就別拒絕我瞓喺你身旁嘅臥室;咁樣躺住,赫米婭,我並冇撒謊。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那就別拒絕我睡在你身旁的臥室;這樣躺著,赫米婭,我並沒有撒謊。

passages.title: Hermia 赫米婭
passages.original: Lysander riddles very prettily.
passages.vernacular: 拉山德嘅謎語講得好漂亮。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 拉山德的謎語說得很漂亮。

passages.original: Now much beshrew my manners and my pride, If Hermia meant to say Lysander lied!
passages.vernacular: 如果赫米婭有意講拉山德撒謊,就該重重責罰我嘅禮貌同驕傲!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果赫米婭有意說拉山德撒謊,就該重重責罰我的禮貌和驕傲!

passages.original: But, gentle friend, for love and courtesy Lie further off, in human modesty, Such separation as may well be said Becomes a virtuous bachelor and a maid, So far be distant;
passages.vernacular: 但係,溫柔嘅朋友,為了愛同禮貌,出於人之常情嘅端莊,躺遠啲,咁樣嘅分隔足以講係適合一位有德嘅單身漢同少女,離得咁遠;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但是,溫柔的朋友,為了愛與禮貌,出於人之常情的端莊,躺遠一點,這樣的分隔足以說是適合一位有德的單身漢和少女,離得這麼遠;

passages.original: and good night, sweet friend: Thy love ne’er alter till thy sweet life end!
passages.vernacular: 晚安,親愛嘅朋友:願你嘅愛直到你甜美生命嘅盡頭永不改變!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 晚安,親愛的朋友:願你的愛直到你甜美生命的盡頭永不改變!

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: Amen, amen, to that fair prayer say I; And then end life when I end loyalty!
passages.vernacular: 對呢美麗嘅祈禱,我講阿哋,阿哋;願我嘅生命隨我嘅忠誠一同終結!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對這美麗的祈禱,我說阿們,阿們;願我的生命隨我的忠誠一同終結!

passages.original: Here is my bed.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係我嘅床。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是我的床。

passages.original: Sleep give thee all his rest!
passages.vernacular: 願瞓眠賜你全部嘅休息!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 願睡眠賜你全部的休息!

passages.title: Hermia 赫米婭
passages.original: With half that wish the wisher’s eyes be pressed!
passages.vernacular: 願呢祝願嘅一半壓上祝願者嘅眼睛!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 願這祝願的一半壓上祝願者的眼睛!

passages.original: [They sleep.]
passages.vernacular: [二人入瞓。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [二人入睡。]

passages.original: Enter Puck.
passages.vernacular: [帕克上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [帕克上。]

passages.title: Puck 帕克
passages.original: Through the forest have I gone, But Athenian found I none, On whose eyes I might approve This flower’s force in stirring love.
passages.vernacular: 我已穿過森林,卻冇找到雅典人,可以喺佢嘅眼上試驗呢花喺激起愛情上嘅力量。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我已穿過森林,卻沒找到雅典人,可以在他的眼上試驗這花在激起愛情上的力量。

passages.original: Night and silence!
passages.vernacular: 夜晚同寂靜!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夜晚和寂靜!

passages.original: Who is here?
passages.vernacular: 呢度係邊個?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這裡是誰?

passages.original: Weeds of Athens he doth wear: This is he, my master said, Despisèd the Athenian maid;
passages.vernacular: 佢穿住雅典嘅衣服:呢個就係我主人講嘅,鄙視雅典少女嘅嗰個;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他穿著雅典的衣服:這就是我主人說的,鄙視雅典少女的那個;

passages.original: And here the maiden, sleeping sound, On the dank and dirty ground.
passages.vernacular: 而呢度係嗰少女,瞓得好沉,躺喺潮濕骯髒嘅地上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 而這裡是那少女,睡得很沉,躺在潮濕骯髒的地上。

passages.original: Pretty soul, she durst not lie Near this lack-love, this kill-courtesy.
passages.vernacular: 可愛嘅靈魂,佢唔敢躺喺呢個缺乏愛心、殺死禮貌嘅人旁邊。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 可愛的靈魂,她不敢躺在這個缺乏愛心、殺死禮貌的人旁邊。

passages.original: Churl, upon thy eyes I throw All the power this charm doth owe;
passages.vernacular: 粗人,我把呢魔法所有嘅力量投喺你眼上;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 粗人,我把這魔法所有的力量投在你眼上;

passages.original: When thou wak’st let love forbid Sleep his seat on thy eyelid.
passages.vernacular: 當你醒嚟,願愛情禁止瞓眠坐喺你嘅眼瞼上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 當你醒來,願愛情禁止睡眠坐在你的眼瞼上。

passages.original: So awake when I am gone; For I must now to Oberon.
passages.vernacular: 所以我走後你就醒嚟;因為我而家必須去見奧布朗。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 所以我走後你就醒來;因為我現在必須去見奧布朗。

passages.original: [Exit.]
Enter Demetrius and Helena, running.
passages.vernacular: [狄米特律斯同海倫娜奔跑上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [狄米特律斯與海倫娜奔跑上。]

passages.title: Helena 海倫娜
passages.original: Stay, though thou kill me, sweet Demetrius.
passages.vernacular: 站住,邊怕你殺我,親愛嘅狄米特律斯。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 站住,哪怕你殺我,親愛的狄米特律斯。

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: I charge thee, hence, and do not haunt me thus.
passages.vernacular: 我命令你,走開,唔好咁樣糾纏我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我命令你,走開,不要這樣糾纏我。

passages.title: Helena 海倫娜
passages.original: O, wilt thou darkling leave me? Do not so.
passages.vernacular: 啊,你要喺黑暗中離開我嗎?別咁樣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,你要在黑暗中離開我嗎?別這樣。

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: Stay, on thy peril; I alone will go.
passages.vernacular: 留下,小心後果;我獨自走。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 留下,小心後果;我獨自走。

passages.original: [Exit Demetrius.]
passages.vernacular: [狄米特律斯下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [狄米特律斯下。]

passages.title: Helena 海倫娜
passages.original: O, I am out of breath in this fond chase!
passages.vernacular: 啊,我喺呢徒勞嘅追逐中喘不過氣!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,我在這徒勞的追逐中喘不過氣!

passages.original: The more my prayer, the lesser is my grace.
passages.vernacular: 我越祈求,我得嘅恩惠越少。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我越祈求,我得的恩惠越少。

passages.original: Happy is Hermia, wheresoe’er she lies, For she hath blessèd and attractive eyes.
passages.vernacular: 赫米婭不論躺喺邊度都幸福,因為佢有蒙福並迷人嘅眼睛。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 赫米婭不論躺在哪裡都幸福,因為她有蒙福並迷人的眼睛。

passages.original: How came her eyes so bright?
passages.vernacular: 佢嘅眼睛點咁明亮?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她的眼睛怎麼這麼明亮?

passages.original: Not with salt tears.
passages.vernacular: 唔係靠鹹淚。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不是靠鹹淚。

passages.original: If so, my eyes are oftener wash’d than hers.
passages.vernacular: 如果係,我嘅眼睛比佢嘅洗得更勤。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果是,我的眼睛比她的洗得更勤。

passages.original: No, no, I am as ugly as a bear, For beasts that meet me run away for fear:
passages.vernacular: 不,不,我醜得像熊,因為遇到我嘅野獸都嚇得跑掉:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,不,我醜得像熊,因為遇到我的野獸都嚇得跑掉:

passages.original: Therefore no marvel though Demetrius Do, as a monster, fly my presence thus.
passages.vernacular: 所以狄米特律斯像躲避怪物一樣躲開我嘅出現都不奇怪。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 所以狄米特律斯像躲避怪物一樣躲開我的出現也不奇怪。

passages.original: What wicked and dissembling glass of mine Made me compare with Hermia’s sphery eyne?
passages.vernacular: 我邊面邪惡虛偽嘅鏡子,讓我攞自己同赫米婭球體般嘅眼睛比?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我哪面邪惡虛偽的鏡子,讓我拿自己同赫米婭球體般的眼睛比?

passages.original: But who is here?
passages.vernacular: 但呢度係邊個?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但這裡是誰?

passages.original: Lysander, on the ground!
passages.vernacular: 拉山德,喺地上!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 拉山德,在地上!

passages.original: Dead or asleep?
passages.vernacular: 死咗定係瞓住?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 死了還是睡著?

passages.original: I see no blood, no wound.
passages.vernacular: 我睇唔見血,冇傷口。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我看不見血,沒有傷口。

passages.original: Lysander, if you live, good sir, awake.
passages.vernacular: 拉山德,如果你活住,好先生,醒醒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 拉山德,如果你活著,好先生,醒醒。

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: [Waking.]
passages.vernacular: [醒嚟。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [醒來。]

passages.original: And run through fire I will for thy sweet sake.
passages.vernacular: 為了你嘅緣故,我願穿過火焰。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為了你的緣故,我願穿過火焰。

passages.original: Transparent Helena!
passages.vernacular: 透明嘅海倫娜!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 透明的海倫娜!

passages.original: Nature shows art, That through thy bosom makes me see thy heart.
passages.vernacular: 大自然顯示技藝,讓我透過你嘅胸膛睇見你嘅心。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大自然顯示技藝,讓我透過你的胸膛看見你的心。

passages.original: Where is Demetrius?
passages.vernacular: 狄米特律斯喺邊度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 狄米特律斯在哪裡?

passages.original: O, how fit a word Is that vile name to perish on my sword!
passages.vernacular: 啊,呢個可憎嘅名字幾咁適合死喺我嘅劍上!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,這個可憎的名字多麼適合死在我的劍上!

passages.title: Helena 海倫娜
passages.original: Do not say so, Lysander, say not so.
passages.vernacular: 別咁樣講,拉山德,別咁樣講。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 別這樣說,拉山德,別這樣說。

passages.original: What though he love your Hermia?
passages.vernacular: 就算佢愛你嘅赫米婭又點樣?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就算他愛你的赫米婭又怎樣?

passages.original: Lord, what though?
passages.vernacular: 主啊,又點樣?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 主啊,又怎樣?

passages.original: Yet Hermia still loves you.
passages.vernacular: 赫米婭仍然愛你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 赫米婭仍然愛你。

passages.original: Then be content.
passages.vernacular: 嗰就滿足吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那就滿足吧。

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: Content with Hermia?
passages.vernacular: 滿足於赫米婭?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 滿足於赫米婭?

passages.original: No, I do repent The tedious minutes I with her have spent.
passages.vernacular: 不,我後悔我同佢度過嘅嗰啲冗長嘅時刻。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,我後悔我同她度過的那些冗長的時刻。

passages.original: Not Hermia, but Helena I love.
passages.vernacular: 我愛嘅唔係赫米婭,而係海倫娜。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我愛的不是赫米婭,而是海倫娜。

passages.original: Who will not change a raven for a dove?
passages.vernacular: 邊個唔願用烏鴉換鴿子?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰不願用烏鴉換鴿子?

passages.original: The will of man is by his reason sway’d, And reason says you are the worthier maid.
passages.vernacular: 人嘅意志受理智支配,而理智講你係更值得嘅少女。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 人的意志受理智支配,而理智說你是更值得的少女。

passages.original: Things growing are not ripe until their season;
passages.vernacular: 生長嘅事物喺佢哋嘅季節之前不成熟;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 生長的事物在它們的季節之前不成熟;

passages.original: So I, being young, till now ripe not to reason;
passages.vernacular: 我年輕,到而家才成熟到能講理;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我年輕,到現在才成熟到能講理;

passages.original: And touching now the point of human skill, Reason becomes the marshal to my will, And leads me to your eyes, where I o’erlook Love’s stories, written in love’s richest book.
passages.vernacular: 而家觸到人類技能嘅頂點,理智成咗我意志嘅統帥,領我到你嘅眼睛前,喺嗰度我瀏覽愛情嘅故事,寫喺愛情最豐富嘅書裡。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在觸到人類技能的頂點,理智成了我意志的統帥,領我到你的眼睛前,在那裡我瀏覽愛情的故事,寫在愛情最豐富的書裡。

passages.title: Helena 海倫娜
passages.original: Wherefore was I to this keen mockery born?
passages.vernacular: 我點解生來就承受呢尖刻嘅嘲弄?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我為什麼生來就承受這尖刻的嘲弄?

passages.original: When at your hands did I deserve this scorn?
passages.vernacular: 我乜嘢時候喺你手上應得咁樣嘅輕蔑?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我什麼時候在你手上應得這樣的輕蔑?

passages.original: Is’t not enough, is’t not enough, young man, That I did never, no, nor never can Deserve a sweet look from Demetrius’ eye, But you must flout my insufficiency?
passages.vernacular: 年輕人,難道唔夠嗎,難道唔夠嗎,我從冇、都永遠唔可能,從狄米特律斯嘅眼中得到一個甜美嘅眼神,你仲必須嘲笑我嘅不足?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 年輕人,難道不夠嗎,難道不夠嗎,我從沒有、也永遠不可能,從狄米特律斯的眼中得到一個甜美的眼神,你還必須嘲笑我的不足?

passages.original: Good troth, you do me wrong, good sooth, you do, In such disdainful manner me to woo.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,你冤枉我,真嘅,你用咁樣輕蔑嘅方式向我求愛。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,你冤枉我,真的,你用這樣輕蔑的方式向我求愛。

passages.original: But fare you well; perforce I must confess, I thought you lord of more true gentleness.
passages.vernacular: 但再會;我唔得不承認,我以為你係更真正有教養嘅人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但再會;我不得不承認,我以為你是更真正有教養的人。

passages.original: O, that a lady of one man refus’d, Should of another therefore be abus’d!
passages.vernacular: 啊,一位被一個男人拒絕嘅小姐,竟因此被另一個男人欺侮!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,一位被一個男人拒絕的小姐,竟因此被另一個男人欺侮!

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: She sees not Hermia.
passages.vernacular: 佢冇睇見赫米婭。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她沒看見赫米婭。

passages.original: Hermia, sleep thou there, And never mayst thou come Lysander near!
passages.vernacular: 赫米婭,你瞓喺嗰度,願你永遠唔好靠近拉山德!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 赫米婭,你睡在那裡,願你永遠不要靠近拉山德!

passages.original: For, as a surfeit of the sweetest things The deepest loathing to the stomach brings;
passages.vernacular: 因為,就像食多咗最甜嘅嘢,會帶畀胃最深嘅厭惡;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 因為,就像吃多了最甜的東西,會帶給胃最深的厭惡;

passages.original: Or as the heresies that men do leave Are hated most of those they did deceive;
passages.vernacular: 或像人哋離棄嘅異端,最被曾受騙嘅人所恨;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 或像人們離棄的異端,最被曾受騙的人所恨;

passages.original: So thou, my surfeit and my heresy, Of all be hated, but the most of me!
passages.vernacular: 你,我嘅過飽同我嘅異端,願所有人都恨你,而我最恨!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你,我的過飽和我的異端,願所有人都恨你,而我最恨!

passages.original: And, all my powers, address your love and might To honour Helen, and to be her knight!
passages.vernacular: 仲有,我所有嘅力量,把你嘅愛同威力用嚟尊崇海倫,做佢嘅騎士!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 還有,我所有的力量,把你的愛與威力用來尊崇海倫,做她的騎士!

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Hermia 赫米婭
passages.original: [Starting.]
passages.vernacular: [驚醒。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [驚醒。]

passages.original: Help me, Lysander, help me!
passages.vernacular: 救我,拉山德,救我!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 救我,拉山德,救我!

passages.original: Do thy best To pluck this crawling serpent from my breast!
passages.vernacular: 盡你全力,把呢爬行嘅蛇從我胸口拔下嚟!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 盡你全力,把這爬行的蛇從我胸口拔下來!

passages.original: Ay me, for pity!
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,可憐可憐我!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,可憐可憐我!

passages.original: What a dream was here!
passages.vernacular: 呢個係乜嘢夢!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是什麼夢!

passages.original: Lysander, look how I do quake with fear.
passages.vernacular: 拉山德,睇我怕得幾咁發抖。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 拉山德,看我怕得多麼發抖。

passages.original: Methought a serpent eat my heart away, And you sat smiling at his cruel prey. Lysander!
passages.vernacular: 我夢見一條蛇食掉我嘅心,而你坐喺嗰度微笑住睇牠殘忍嘅獵物。拉山德!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我夢見一條蛇吃掉我的心,而你坐在那裡微笑著看牠殘忍的獵物。拉山德!

passages.original: What, removed? Lysander! lord!
passages.vernacular: 點,走開喇?拉山德!大人!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼,走開了?拉山德!大人!

passages.original: What, out of hearing? Gone?
passages.vernacular: 點,聽唔見?走喇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼,聽不見?走了?

passages.original: No sound, no word?
passages.vernacular: 冇聲音,冇話?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒聲音,沒話?

passages.original: Alack, where are you?
passages.vernacular: 唉,你喺邊度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 唉,你在哪裡?

passages.original: Speak, and if you hear; Speak, of all loves!
passages.vernacular: 講話,如果你聽見;睇喺所有愛嘅份上,講話!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說話,如果你聽見;看在所有愛的份上,說話!

passages.original: I swoon almost with fear. No?
passages.vernacular: 我幾乎嚇得昏過去。冇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我幾乎嚇得昏過去。沒有?

passages.original: Then I well perceive you are not nigh.
passages.vernacular: 嗰我清楚知道你不喺附近。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那我清楚知道你不在附近。

passages.original: Either death or you I’ll find immediately.
passages.vernacular: 我會即刻找到死亡或你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我會立刻找到死亡或你。

passages.original: [Exit.]

chapters.title: Act III, Scene I — The Wood 第三幕第一場:樹林

passages.original: The Queen of Fairies still lying asleep.
passages.vernacular: [仙后仍躺住瞓覺。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [仙后仍躺著睡覺。]

passages.original: Enter Bottom, Quince, Snout, Starveling, Snug and Flute.
passages.vernacular: [波頓、昆斯、斯諾特、斯塔夫林、斯納格同弗魯特上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [波頓、昆斯、斯諾特、斯塔夫林、斯納格與弗魯特上。]

passages.title: Bottom 波頓
passages.original: Are we all met?
passages.vernacular: 我哋都到齊咗嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們都到齊了嗎?

passages.title: Quince 昆斯
passages.original: Pat, pat; and here’s a marvellous convenient place for our rehearsal.
passages.vernacular: 恰恰好;呢度係個極便利嘅排練地方。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 恰恰好;這裡是個極便利的排練地方。

passages.original: This green plot shall be our stage, this hawthorn brake our tiring-house;
passages.vernacular: 呢塊綠地就係我哋嘅舞台,呢片山楂叢就係我哋嘅更衣室;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這塊綠地就是我們的舞台,這片山楂叢就是我們的更衣室;

passages.original: and we will do it in action, as we will do it before the Duke.
passages.vernacular: 我哋要像喺公爵面前嗰樣,用動作演出嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們要像在公爵面前那樣,用動作演出來。

passages.title: Bottom 波頓
passages.original: Peter Quince?
passages.vernacular: 彼得·昆斯?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 彼得·昆斯?

passages.title: Quince 昆斯
passages.original: What sayest thou, bully Bottom?
passages.vernacular: 你講乜嘢,好夥計波頓?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你說什麼,好夥計波頓?

passages.title: Bottom 波頓
passages.original: There are things in this comedy of Pyramus and Thisbe that will never please.
passages.vernacular: 呢齣皮拉姆斯同提斯柏嘅喜劇裡有些嘢永遠唔會討好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這齣皮拉姆斯和提斯柏的喜劇裡有些東西永遠不會討好。

passages.original: First, Pyramus must draw a sword to kill himself;
passages.vernacular: 首先,皮拉姆斯必須拔劍自殺;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 首先,皮拉姆斯必須拔劍自殺;

passages.original: which the ladies cannot abide.
passages.vernacular: 嗰個係女士哋受不了嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那是女士們受不了的。

passages.original: How answer you that?
passages.vernacular: 你點回答?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你怎麼回答?

passages.title: Snout 斯諾特
passages.original: By’r lakin, a parlous fear.
passages.vernacular: 天呀,真係個可怕嘅擔憂。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 天哪,真是個可怕的擔憂。

passages.title: Starveling 斯塔夫林
passages.original: I believe we must leave the killing out, when all is done.
passages.vernacular: 我相信到頭嚟我哋必須把殺人攞掉。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我相信到頭來我們必須把殺人拿掉。

passages.title: Bottom 波頓
passages.original: Not a whit; I have a device to make all well.
passages.vernacular: 啲都不;我有個辦法把一切弄好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一點也不;我有個辦法把一切弄好。

passages.original: Write me a prologue, and let the prologue seem to say we will do no harm with our swords, and that Pyramus is not killed indeed;
passages.vernacular: 畀我寫個開場白,讓開場白似乎喺講我哋用劍唔會傷害人,皮拉姆斯並冇真嘅被殺;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 給我寫個開場白,讓開場白似乎在說我們用劍不會傷害人,皮拉姆斯並沒有真的被殺;

passages.original: and for the more better assurance, tell them that I Pyramus am not Pyramus but Bottom the weaver.
passages.vernacular: 為了更保險,告訴佢哋我皮拉姆斯唔係皮拉姆斯,而係織工波頓。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為了更保險,告訴他們我皮拉姆斯不是皮拉姆斯,而是織工波頓。

passages.original: This will put them out of fear.
passages.vernacular: 呢會讓佢哋唔再害怕。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這會讓他們不再害怕。

passages.title: Quince 昆斯
passages.original: Well, we will have such a prologue; and it shall be written in eight and six.
passages.vernacular: 好,我哋會有咁樣一個開場白;佢要用八六音步寫。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,我們會有這樣一個開場白;它要用八六音步寫。

passages.title: Bottom 波頓
passages.original: No, make it two more; let it be written in eight and eight.
passages.vernacular: 不,再加兩個;就寫成八八音步。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,再加兩個;就寫成八八音步。

passages.title: Snout 斯諾特
passages.original: Will not the ladies be afeard of the lion?
passages.vernacular: 女士哋唔會怕獅子嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 女士們不會怕獅子嗎?

passages.title: Starveling 斯塔夫林
passages.original: I fear it, I promise you.
passages.vernacular: 我怕,我向你保證。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我怕,我向你保證。

passages.title: Bottom 波頓
passages.original: Masters, you ought to consider with yourselves, to bring in (God shield us!)
passages.vernacular: 各位,你哋應該自己考慮,把(上帝保佑我哋!)
passages.vernacularMandarin: 各位,你們應該自己考慮,把(上帝保佑我們!)

passages.original: a lion among ladies is a most dreadful thing.
passages.vernacular: 一頭獅子帶到女士哋中間係極可怕嘅事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一頭獅子帶到女士們中間是極可怕的事。

passages.original: For there is not a more fearful wild-fowl than your lion living;
passages.vernacular: 因為活住嘅野禽中冇比你哋嘅獅子更可怕嘅;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 因為活著的野禽中沒有比你們的獅子更可怕的;

passages.original: and we ought to look to it.
passages.vernacular: 我哋應該留意呢個。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們應該留意這個。

passages.title: Snout 斯諾特
passages.original: Therefore another prologue must tell he is not a lion.
passages.vernacular: 所以另一篇開場白必須講佢唔係獅子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 所以另一篇開場白必須說他不是獅子。

passages.title: Bottom 波頓
passages.original: Nay, you must name his name, and half his face must be seen through the lion’s neck;
passages.vernacular: 不,你必須講出佢嘅名字,佢嘅半張臉要從獅子嘅脖子裡露出嚟;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,你必須說出他的名字,他的半張臉要從獅子的脖子裡露出來;

passages.original: and he himself must speak through, saying thus, or to the same defect:
passages.vernacular: 佢自己要從裡面講話,咁樣講,或類似嘅話:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他自己要從裡面說話,這樣說,或類似的話:

passages.original: ‘Ladies,’ or, ‘Fair ladies, I would wish you,’ or, ‘I would request you,’ or, ’I would entreat you, not to fear, not to tremble: my life for yours.
passages.vernacular: 「女士哋,」或「美麗嘅女士哋,我希望你哋,」或「我請求你哋,」或「我懇求你哋,唔好怕,唔好發抖:我攞我嘅命擔保你哋嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 「女士們,」或「美麗的女士們,我希望你們,」或「我請求你們,」或「我懇求你們,不要怕,不要發抖:我拿我的命擔保你們的。

passages.original: If you think I come hither as a lion, it were pity of my life.
passages.vernacular: 如果你哋以為我嚟呢度係頭獅子,嗰我嘅命就可惜喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你們以為我來這裡是頭獅子,那我的命就可惜了。

passages.original: No, I am no such thing; I am a man as other men are’:
passages.vernacular: 不,我唔係咁樣嘅嘢;我係同別人一樣嘅人」:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,我不是這樣的東西;我是和別人一樣的人」:

passages.original: and there, indeed, let him name his name, and tell them plainly he is Snug the joiner.
passages.vernacular: 然後,確實,讓佢講出佢嘅名字,清楚地告訴佢哋佢係細木工斯納格。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 然後,確實,讓他說出他的名字,清楚地告訴他們他是細木工斯納格。

passages.title: Quince 昆斯
passages.original: Well, it shall be so.
passages.vernacular: 好,就咁樣吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,就這樣吧。

passages.original: But there is two hard things: that is, to bring the moonlight into a chamber, for you know, Pyramus and Thisbe meet by moonlight.
passages.vernacular: 但仲有兩件難事:就係把月光帶進一個房間,因為你哋知道,皮拉姆斯同提斯柏係喺月光下相會嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但還有兩件難事:就是把月光帶進一個房間,因為你們知道,皮拉姆斯和提斯柏是在月光下相會的。

passages.title: Snout 斯諾特
passages.original: Doth the moon shine that night we play our play?
passages.vernacular: 我哋演戲嗰晚月亮照耀嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們演戲那晚月亮照耀嗎?

passages.title: Bottom 波頓
passages.original: A calendar, a calendar!
passages.vernacular: 一本曆書,一本曆書!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一本曆書,一本曆書!

passages.original: Look in the almanack; find out moonshine, find out moonshine.
passages.vernacular: 睇睇年曆;找出月光,找出月光。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看看年曆;找出月光,找出月光。

passages.title: Quince 昆斯
passages.original: Yes, it doth shine that night.
passages.vernacular: 係嘅,嗰晚月亮會照。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是的,那晚月亮會照。

passages.title: Bottom 波頓
passages.original: Why, then may you leave a casement of the great chamber window, where we play, open;
passages.vernacular: 哎,嗰你哋可以把我哋演戲嘅大廳窗戶嘅一扇小窗打開;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎,那你們可以把我們演戲的大廳窗戶的一扇小窗打開;

passages.original: and the moon may shine in at the casement.
passages.vernacular: 月亮就可以從小窗照進嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 月亮就可以從小窗照進來。

passages.title: Quince 昆斯
passages.original: Ay; or else one must come in with a bush of thorns and a lantern, and say he comes to disfigure or to present the person of Moonshine.
passages.vernacular: 對;否則就必須有人攞住一束荊棘同一盞燈籠進嚟,講佢嚟扮演或代表月光嘅角色。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對;否則就必須有人拿著一束荊棘和一盞燈籠進來,說他來扮演或代表月光的角色。

passages.original: Then there is another thing: we must have a wall in the great chamber;
passages.vernacular: 然後仲有另一件事:我哋喺大廳裡必須有一堵牆;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 然後還有另一件事:我們在大廳裡必須有一堵牆;

passages.original: for Pyramus and Thisbe, says the story, did talk through the chink of a wall.
passages.vernacular: 因為故事講,皮拉姆斯同提斯柏係隔住牆縫講話嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 因為故事說,皮拉姆斯和提斯柏是隔著牆縫說話的。

passages.title: Snout 斯諾特
passages.original: You can never bring in a wall.
passages.vernacular: 你永遠帶不進一堵牆。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你永遠帶不進一堵牆。

passages.original: What say you, Bottom?
passages.vernacular: 你點講,波頓?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你怎麼說,波頓?

passages.title: Bottom 波頓
passages.original: Some man or other must present Wall.
passages.vernacular: 必須有人嚟扮演牆。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 必須有人來扮演牆。

passages.original: And let him have some plaster, or some loam, or some rough-cast about him, to signify wall;
passages.vernacular: 讓佢身上有些灰泥、或黏土、或粗灰漿,表示牆;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓他身上有些灰泥、或黏土、或粗灰漿,表示牆;

passages.original: and let him hold his fingers thus, and through that cranny shall Pyramus and Thisbe whisper.
passages.vernacular: 讓佢咁樣舉著手指,皮拉姆斯同提斯柏就從嗰縫隙裡講悄悄話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓他這樣舉著手指,皮拉姆斯和提斯柏就從那縫隙裡說悄悄話。

passages.title: Quince 昆斯
passages.original: If that may be, then all is well.
passages.vernacular: 如果可以咁樣,就一切都好喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果可以這樣,就一切都好了。

passages.original: Come, sit down, every mother’s son, and rehearse your parts.
passages.vernacular: 嚟,坐下,每個母親嘅兒子,排練你哋嘅角色。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,坐下,每個母親的兒子,排練你們的角色。

passages.original: Pyramus, you begin: when you have spoken your speech, enter into that brake;
passages.vernacular: 皮拉姆斯,你先開始:講完你嘅台詞,就進嗰片灌木叢;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 皮拉姆斯,你先開始:說完你的台詞,就進那片灌木叢;

passages.original: and so everyone according to his cue.
passages.vernacular: 其他人各按提示出場。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 其他人各按提示出場。

passages.original: Enter Puck behind.
passages.vernacular: [帕克喺後面上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [帕克在後面上。]

passages.title: Puck 帕克
passages.original: What hempen homespuns have we swaggering here, So near the cradle of the Fairy Queen?
passages.vernacular: 我哋呢度有些乜嘢麻布粗衣嘅人喺大搖大擺,離仙后嘅搖籃咁近?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們這裡有些什麼麻布粗衣的人在大搖大擺,離仙后的搖籃這麼近?

passages.original: What, a play toward?
passages.vernacular: 點,要演戲嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼,要演戲嗎?

passages.original: I’ll be an auditor; An actor too perhaps, if I see cause.
passages.vernacular: 我嚟做觀眾;或者仲做個演員,如果我覺得有理由。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我來做觀眾;也許還做個演員,如果我覺得有理由。

passages.title: Quince 昆斯
passages.original: Speak, Pyramus.—Thisbe, stand forth.
passages.vernacular: 講,皮拉姆斯。——提斯柏,上前。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說,皮拉姆斯。——提斯柏,上前。

passages.title: Pyramus 皮拉姆斯
passages.original: Thisbe, the flowers of odious savours sweet
passages.vernacular: 提斯柏,可憎氣味嘅花朵甜美
passages.vernacularMandarin: 提斯柏,可憎氣味的花朵甜美

passages.title: Quince 昆斯
passages.original: Odours, odours.
passages.vernacular: 氣味,氣味。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 氣味,氣味。

passages.title: Pyramus 皮拉姆斯
passages.original: . . . odours savours sweet.
passages.vernacular: ……氣味甜美。
passages.vernacularMandarin: ……氣味甜美。

passages.original: So hath thy breath, my dearest Thisbe dear.
passages.vernacular: 你嘅呼吸都一樣,我最親愛嘅提斯柏。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你的呼吸也一樣,我最親愛的提斯柏。

passages.original: But hark, a voice!
passages.vernacular: 但聽,一個聲音!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但聽,一個聲音!

passages.original: Stay thou but here awhile, And by and by I will to thee appear.
passages.vernacular: 你喺呢度稍等,我即刻就喺你面前出現。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你在這裡稍等,我馬上就在你面前出現。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Puck 帕克
passages.original: A stranger Pyramus than e’er played here!
passages.vernacular: 有史以來呢度演過嘅最奇怪嘅皮拉姆斯!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有史以來這裡演過的最奇怪的皮拉姆斯!

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Thisbe 提斯柏
passages.original: Must I speak now?
passages.vernacular: 我而家要講嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我現在要說嗎?

passages.title: Quince 昆斯
passages.original: Ay, marry, must you, For you must understand he goes but to see a noise that he heard, and is to come again.
passages.vernacular: 對,講真嘅,你要講,因為你必須明白,佢只係去睇佢聽到嘅一個聲響,仲要再回嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對,說真的,你要說,因為你必須明白,他只是去看他聽到的一個聲響,還要再回來。

passages.title: Thisbe 提斯柏
passages.original: Most radiant Pyramus, most lily-white of hue, Of colour like the red rose on triumphant brier, Most brisky juvenal, and eke most lovely Jew, As true as truest horse, that yet would never tire, I’ll meet thee, Pyramus, at Ninny’s tomb.
passages.vernacular: 最光輝嘅皮拉姆斯,膚色最像百合般潔白,顏色像勝利荊棘上嘅紅玫瑰,最活潑嘅少年,又係最可愛嘅猶太人,像最忠實嘅馬一樣忠實,從不疲倦,我會喺尼尼嘅墳墓同你會面,皮拉姆斯。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 最光輝的皮拉姆斯,膚色最像百合般潔白,顏色像勝利荊棘上的紅玫瑰,最活潑的少年,又是最可愛的猶太人,像最忠實的馬一樣忠實,從不疲倦,我會在尼尼的墳墓與你會面,皮拉姆斯。

passages.title: Quince 昆斯
passages.original: Ninus’ tomb, man!
passages.vernacular: 係尼努斯嘅墳墓,老兄!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是尼努斯的墳墓,老兄!

passages.original: Why, you must not speak that yet.
passages.vernacular: 哎,你而家仲不該講嗰個。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎,你現在還不該說那個。

passages.original: That you answer to Pyramus.
passages.vernacular: 嗰個係你回答皮拉姆斯嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那是你回答皮拉姆斯的。

passages.original: You speak all your part at once, cues, and all.—Pyramus enter!
passages.vernacular: 你把你嘅全部台詞,提示同一切,一次講完喇。——皮拉姆斯上場!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你把你的全部台詞,提示和一切,一次說完了。——皮拉姆斯上場!

passages.original: Your cue is past; it is ‘never tire.’
passages.vernacular: 你嘅提示已經過喇;係「從不疲倦」。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你的提示已經過了;是「從不疲倦」。

passages.title: Thisbe 提斯柏
passages.original: O, As true as truest horse, that yet would never tire.
passages.vernacular: 啊,像最忠實嘅馬一樣忠實,從不疲倦。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,像最忠實的馬一樣忠實,從不疲倦。

passages.original: Enter Puck and Bottom with an ass’s head.
passages.vernacular: [帕克同頭戴驢頭嘅波頓上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [帕克與頭戴驢頭的波頓上。]

passages.title: Pyramus 皮拉姆斯
passages.original: If I were fair, Thisbe, I were only thine.
passages.vernacular: 如果我係美嘅,提斯柏,我就只屬於你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果我是美的,提斯柏,我就只屬於你。

passages.title: Quince 昆斯
passages.original: O monstrous! O strange!
passages.vernacular: 啊,怪物!啊,奇事!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,怪物!啊,奇事!

passages.original: We are haunted.
passages.vernacular: 我哋被鬼纏喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們被鬼纏了。

passages.original: Pray, masters, fly, masters! Help!
passages.vernacular: 求你哋,各位,逃吧,各位!救命!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 求你們,各位,逃吧,各位!救命!

passages.original: [Exeunt Clowns.]
passages.vernacular: [小丑哋下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [小丑們下。]

passages.title: Puck 帕克
passages.original: I’ll follow you.
passages.vernacular: 我嚟追你哋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我來追你們。

passages.original: I’ll lead you about a round, Through bog, through bush, through brake, through brier;
passages.vernacular: 我要領你哋繞圈,穿過沼澤,穿過灌木,穿過樹叢,穿過荊棘;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要領你們繞圈,穿過沼澤,穿過灌木,穿過樹叢,穿過荊棘;

passages.original: Sometime a horse I’ll be, sometime a hound, A hog, a headless bear, sometime a fire;
passages.vernacular: 有時我係馬,有時係獵犬,係豬,係無頭熊,有時係火;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有時我是馬,有時是獵犬,是豬,是無頭熊,有時是火;

passages.original: And neigh, and bark, and grunt, and roar, and burn, Like horse, hound, hog, bear, fire, at every turn.
passages.vernacular: 嘶鳴、吠叫、哼叫、咆哮、燃燒,像馬、獵犬、豬、熊、火,喺每個轉角。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 嘶鳴、吠叫、哼叫、咆哮、燃燒,像馬、獵犬、豬、熊、火,在每個轉角。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Bottom 波頓
passages.original: Why do they run away?
passages.vernacular: 佢哋點解跑掉?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他們為什麼跑掉?

passages.original: This is a knavery of them to make me afeard.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係佢哋嘅詭計,要嚇我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是他們的詭計,要嚇我。

passages.original: Enter Snout.
passages.vernacular: [斯諾特上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [斯諾特上。]

passages.title: Snout 斯諾特
passages.original: O Bottom, thou art changed!
passages.vernacular: 啊波頓,你變喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊波頓,你變了!

passages.original: What do I see on thee?
passages.vernacular: 我喺你身上睇見乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我在你身上看見什麼?

passages.title: Bottom 波頓
passages.original: What do you see?
passages.vernacular: 你睇見乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你看見什麼?

passages.original: You see an ass-head of your own, do you?
passages.vernacular: 你睇見你自己嘅驢頭,係吧?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你看見你自己的驢頭,是吧?

passages.original: [Exit Snout.]
passages.vernacular: [斯諾特下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [斯諾特下。]

passages.original: Enter Quince.
passages.vernacular: [昆斯上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [昆斯上。]

passages.title: Quince 昆斯
passages.original: Bless thee, Bottom! bless thee!
passages.vernacular: 保佑你,波頓!保佑你!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 保佑你,波頓!保佑你!

passages.original: Thou art translated.
passages.vernacular: 你被轉化喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你被轉化了。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Bottom 波頓
passages.original: I see their knavery.
passages.vernacular: 我睇出佢哋嘅詭計。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我看出他們的詭計。

passages.original: This is to make an ass of me, to fright me, if they could.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係要把我當驢子,盡可能嚇我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是要把我當驢子,盡可能嚇我。

passages.original: But I will not stir from this place, do what they can.
passages.vernacular: 但不管佢哋點做,我都唔會離開呢個地方。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但不管他們怎麼做,我也不會離開這個地方。

passages.original: I will walk up and down here, and I will sing, that they shall hear I am not afraid. [Sings.]
passages.vernacular: 我要喺呢度走嚟走去,我要唱歌,好讓佢哋聽見我不怕。[唱。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要在這裡走來走去,我要唱歌,好讓他們聽見我不怕。[唱。]

passages.original: The ousel cock, so black of hue, With orange-tawny bill, The throstle with his note so true, The wren with little quill.
passages.vernacular: 黑烏鶇公鳥,黑色羽毛,橙黃褐色嘅嘴,畫眉歌聲咁準確,鷦鷯有小小嘅羽管。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 黑烏鶇公鳥,黑色羽毛,橙黃褐色的嘴,畫眉歌聲這麼準確,鷦鷯有小小的羽管。

passages.title: Titania 蒂塔妮婭
passages.original: [Waking.]
passages.vernacular: [醒嚟。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [醒來。]

passages.original: What angel wakes me from my flowery bed?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢天使把我從花床上吵醒?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼天使把我從花床上吵醒?

passages.title: Bottom 波頓
passages.original: [Sings.]
The finch, the sparrow, and the lark, The plain-song cuckoo gray, Whose note full many a man doth mark, And dares not answer nay. for, indeed, who would set his wit to so foolish a bird?
passages.vernacular: 燕雀、麻雀同雲雀,素歌嘅灰色杜鵑,佢嘅歌許多人留意,唔敢答個「不」。因為,講真嘅,邊個會把機智花喺咁蠢嘅鳥上?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 燕雀、麻雀和雲雀,素歌的灰色杜鵑,它的歌許多人留意,不敢答個「不」。因為,說真的,誰會把機智花在這麼蠢的鳥上?

passages.original: Who would give a bird the lie, though he cry ‘cuckoo’ never so?
passages.vernacular: 邊個會對一隻鳥講謊,不管牠點樣叫「布穀」?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰會對一隻鳥說謊,不管牠怎樣叫「布穀」?

passages.title: Titania 蒂塔妮婭
passages.original: I pray thee, gentle mortal, sing again.
passages.vernacular: 求你,溫柔嘅凡人,再唱一遍。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 求你,溫柔的凡人,再唱一遍。

passages.original: Mine ear is much enamour’d of thy note.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅耳朵好迷戀你嘅歌聲。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的耳朵很迷戀你的歌聲。

passages.original: So is mine eye enthrallèd to thy shape; And thy fair virtue’s force perforce doth move me, On the first view, to say, to swear, I love thee.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅眼睛都被你嘅形狀迷住;你美好品質嘅力量迫使我,初見就要講,要發誓,我愛你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的眼睛也被你的形狀迷住;你美好品質的力量迫使我,初見就要說,要發誓,我愛你。

passages.title: Bottom 波頓
passages.original: Methinks, mistress, you should have little reason for that.
passages.vernacular: 我想,小姐,您冇多少理由咁樣講。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我想,小姐,您沒多少理由這樣說。

passages.original: And yet, to say the truth, reason and love keep little company together nowadays.
passages.vernacular: 不過講真話,如今理智同愛情好少同喺一起。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不過說真話,如今理智和愛情很少同在一起。

passages.original: The more the pity that some honest neighbours will not make them friends.
passages.vernacular: 更可惜嘅係,有些誠實嘅鄰居唔肯讓佢哋做朋友。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 更可惜的是,有些誠實的鄰居不肯讓它們做朋友。

passages.original: Nay, I can gleek upon occasion.
passages.vernacular: 不,我有機會都能講俏皮話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,我有機會也能說俏皮話。

passages.title: Titania 蒂塔妮婭
passages.original: Thou art as wise as thou art beautiful.
passages.vernacular: 你既聰明又美麗。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你既聰明又美麗。

passages.title: Bottom 波頓
passages.original: Not so, neither; but if I had wit enough to get out of this wood, I have enough to serve mine own turn.
passages.vernacular: 都唔係咁樣;但如果我有足夠智慧走出呢片樹林,我就有足夠嘅智慧夠我自己用喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 也不是這樣;但如果我有足夠智慧走出這片樹林,我就有足夠的智慧夠我自己用了。

passages.title: Titania 蒂塔妮婭
passages.original: Out of this wood do not desire to go.
passages.vernacular: 唔好想離開呢片樹林。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不要想離開這片樹林。

passages.original: Thou shalt remain here whether thou wilt or no.
passages.vernacular: 不論你願唔願意,你都要留喺呢度。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不論你願不願意,你都要留在這裡。

passages.original: I am a spirit of no common rate.
passages.vernacular: 我係一個不尋常等級嘅精靈。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我是一個不尋常等級的精靈。

passages.original: The summer still doth tend upon my state; And I do love thee: therefore, go with me.
passages.vernacular: 夏天總是侍奉我嘅王國;我愛你:所以,跟我嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夏天總是侍奉我的王國;我愛你:所以,跟我來。

passages.original: I’ll give thee fairies to attend on thee; And they shall fetch thee jewels from the deep, And sing, while thou on pressèd flowers dost sleep.
passages.vernacular: 我畀你仙子哋嚟侍候你;佢哋會從深處取珠寶畀你,喺你瞓喺壓平嘅花上時為你歌唱。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我給你仙子們來侍候你;他們會從深處取珠寶給你,在你睡在壓平的花上時為你歌唱。

passages.original: And I will purge thy mortal grossness so That thou shalt like an airy spirit go.— Peaseblossom! Cobweb! Moth!
passages.vernacular: 我要淨化你凡人嘅粗俗,使你像空氣般嘅精靈一樣走動。——豆花!蛛網!飛蛾!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要淨化你凡人的粗俗,使你像空氣般的精靈一樣走動。——豆花!蛛網!飛蛾!

passages.original: and Mustardseed!
passages.vernacular: 仲有芥子!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 還有芥子!

passages.original: Enter four Fairies.
passages.vernacular: [四個仙子上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [四個仙子上。]

passages.title: Peaseblossom 豆花
passages.original: Ready.
passages.vernacular: 喺。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在。

passages.title: Cobweb 蛛網
passages.original: And I.
passages.vernacular: 我都喺。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我也在。

passages.title: Moth 飛蛾
passages.original: And I.
passages.vernacular: 我都喺。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我也在。

passages.title: Mustardseed 芥子
passages.original: And I.
passages.vernacular: 我都喺。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我也在。

passages.title: All 眾人
passages.original: Where shall we go?
passages.vernacular: 我哋去邊度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們去哪裡?

passages.title: Titania 蒂塔妮婭
passages.original: Be kind and courteous to this gentleman; Hop in his walks and gambol in his eyes;
passages.vernacular: 對呢位紳士要仁慈有禮;喺佢嘅路上蹦跳,喺佢眼前嬉戲;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對這位紳士要仁慈有禮;在他的路上蹦跳,在他眼前嬉戲;

passages.original: Feed him with apricocks and dewberries, With purple grapes, green figs, and mulberries;
passages.vernacular: 用杏子同黑莓餵佢,用紫葡萄、綠無花果同桑葚;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 用杏子和黑莓餵他,用紫葡萄、綠無花果和桑葚;

passages.original: The honey-bags steal from the humble-bees, And for night-tapers, crop their waxen thighs, And light them at the fiery glow-worm’s eyes, To have my love to bed and to arise;
passages.vernacular: 從熊蜂嗰度偷蜜囊,為夜裡嘅蠟燭,剪下牠哋蠟質嘅大腿,喺發光嘅螢火蟲眼睛上點燃,陪我嘅愛人上床同起床;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 從熊蜂那裡偷蜜囊,為夜裡的蠟燭,剪下牠們蠟質的大腿,在發光的螢火蟲眼睛上點燃,陪我的愛人上床和起床;

passages.original: And pluck the wings from painted butterflies, To fan the moonbeams from his sleeping eyes.
passages.vernacular: 拔下彩蝶嘅翅膀,為佢扇走瞓眠中眼睛上嘅月光。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 拔下彩蝶的翅膀,為他扇走睡眠中眼睛上的月光。

passages.original: Nod to him, elves, and do him courtesies.
passages.vernacular: 對佢點頭,小精靈哋,向佢行禮。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對他點頭,小精靈們,向他行禮。

passages.title: Peaseblossom 豆花
passages.original: Hail, mortal!
passages.vernacular: 向你致敬,凡人!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 向你致敬,凡人!

passages.title: Cobweb 蛛網
passages.original: Hail!
passages.vernacular: 致敬!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 致敬!

passages.title: Moth 飛蛾
passages.original: Hail!
passages.vernacular: 致敬!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 致敬!

passages.title: Mustardseed 芥子
passages.original: Hail!
passages.vernacular: 致敬!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 致敬!

passages.title: Bottom 波頓
passages.original: I cry your worships mercy, heartily.—I beseech your worship’s name.
passages.vernacular: 我衷心請各位大人原諒。——我懇請問您尊姓大名。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我衷心請各位大人原諒。——我懇請問您尊姓大名。

passages.title: Cobweb 蛛網
passages.original: Cobweb.
passages.vernacular: 蛛網。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 蛛網。

passages.title: Bottom 波頓
passages.original: I shall desire you of more acquaintance, good Master Cobweb.
passages.vernacular: 我希望同您更熟悉,好蛛網先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我希望同您更熟悉,好蛛網先生。

passages.original: If I cut my finger, I shall make bold with you.—Your name, honest gentleman?
passages.vernacular: 如果我割破手指,我會冒昧用您。——您嘅名字,誠實嘅紳士?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果我割破手指,我會冒昧用您。——您的名字,誠實的紳士?

passages.title: Peaseblossom 豆花
passages.original: Peaseblossom.
passages.vernacular: 豆花。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 豆花。

passages.title: Bottom 波頓
passages.original: I pray you, commend me to Mistress Squash, your mother, and to Master Peascod, your father.
passages.vernacular: 請替我問候您母親南瓜夫人,同您父親豌豆莢先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請替我問候您母親南瓜夫人,和您父親豌豆莢先生。

passages.original: Good Master Peaseblossom, I shall desire you of more acquaintance too.—Your name, I beseech you, sir?
passages.vernacular: 好豆花先生,我都希望同您更熟悉。——您嘅名字,請問,先生?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好豆花先生,我也希望同您更熟悉。——您的名字,請問,先生?

passages.title: Mustardseed 芥子
passages.original: Mustardseed.
passages.vernacular: 芥子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 芥子。

passages.title: Bottom 波頓
passages.original: Good Master Mustardseed, I know your patience well.
passages.vernacular: 好芥子先生,我好清楚您嘅忍耐。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好芥子先生,我很清楚您的忍耐。

passages.original: That same cowardly giant-like ox-beef hath devoured many a gentleman of your house.
passages.vernacular: 嗰個膽小嘅、像巨人嘅牛肉,吞食咗您家族許多紳士。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那個膽小的、像巨人的牛肉,吞吃了您家族許多紳士。

passages.original: I promise you, your kindred hath made my eyes water ere now.
passages.vernacular: 我向您保證,您嘅親戚以前已使我嘅眼睛流過淚。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我向您保證,您的親戚以前已使我的眼睛流過淚。

passages.original: I desire you of more acquaintance, good Master Mustardseed.
passages.vernacular: 我希望同您更熟悉,好芥子先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我希望同您更熟悉,好芥子先生。

passages.title: Titania 蒂塔妮婭
passages.original: Come, wait upon him; lead him to my bower.
passages.vernacular: 嚟,侍候佢;領佢到我嘅閨房。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,侍候他;領他到我的閨房。

passages.original: The moon, methinks, looks with a watery eye, And when she weeps, weeps every little flower, Lamenting some enforced chastity.
passages.vernacular: 月亮,我覺得,眼裡含住水,佢哭時,每朵小花都哭,哀悼某種被迫嘅貞潔。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 月亮,我覺得,眼裡含著水,她哭時,每朵小花都哭,哀悼某種被迫的貞潔。

passages.original: Tie up my love’s tongue, bring him silently.
passages.vernacular: 綁住我愛人嘅舌頭,安靜地帶佢嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 綁住我愛人的舌頭,安靜地帶他來。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act III, Scene II — Another Part of the Wood 第三幕第二場:樹林另一處

passages.original: Enter Oberon.
passages.vernacular: [奧布朗上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧布朗上。]

passages.title: Oberon 奧布朗
passages.original: I wonder if Titania be awak’d; Then, what it was that next came in her eye, Which she must dote on in extremity.
passages.vernacular: 我想知道蒂塔妮婭醒咗冇;咁,佢眼睛裡下一個出現嘅係乜嘢,佢必定極度迷戀。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我想知道蒂塔妮婭醒了沒有;那麼,她眼睛裡下一個出現的是什麼,她必定極度迷戀。

passages.original: Enter Puck.
passages.vernacular: [帕克上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [帕克上。]

passages.title: Oberon 奧布朗
passages.original: Here comes my messenger.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅信使嚟喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的信使來了。

passages.original: How now, mad spirit?
passages.vernacular: 點喇,瘋狂嘅精靈?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼了,瘋狂的精靈?

passages.original: What night-rule now about this haunted grove?
passages.vernacular: 呢鬧鬼嘅樹林裡而家有乜嘢夜間嘅把戲?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這鬧鬼的樹林裡現在有什麼夜間的把戲?

passages.title: Puck 帕克
passages.original: My mistress with a monster is in love.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅女主人愛上咗一個怪物。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的女主人愛上了一個怪物。

passages.original: Near to her close and consecrated bower, While she was in her dull and sleeping hour, A crew of patches, rude mechanicals, That work for bread upon Athenian stalls, Were met together to rehearse a play Intended for great Theseus’ nuptial day.
passages.vernacular: 喺佢隱秘神聖嘅閨房附近,當佢處於沉悶嘅瞓眠時刻,一群補丁般嘅粗魯工匠,喺雅典攤子上為麵包勞作嘅人,聚喺一起排練一齣戲,要喺偉大忒修斯嘅婚禮日上演。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在她隱秘神聖的閨房附近,當她處於沉悶的睡眠時刻,一群補丁般的粗魯工匠,在雅典攤子上為麵包勞作的人,聚在一起排練一齣戲,要在偉大忒修斯的婚禮日上演。

passages.original: The shallowest thick-skin of that barren sort Who Pyramus presented in their sport, Forsook his scene and enter’d in a brake.
passages.vernacular: 嗰群愚笨群體中最淺薄嘅厚皮,喺佢哋戲中扮演皮拉姆斯嘅,離開佢嘅場景進咗灌木叢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那群愚笨群體中最淺薄的厚皮,在他們戲中扮演皮拉姆斯的,離開他的場景進了灌木叢。

passages.original: When I did him at this advantage take, An ass’s nole I fixed on his head.
passages.vernacular: 當我趁此機會抓住佢,我喺佢頭上安咗一個驢腦袋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 當我趁此機會抓住他,我在他頭上安了一個驢腦袋。

passages.original: Anon, his Thisbe must be answerèd, And forth my mimic comes.
passages.vernacular: 不久,佢嘅提斯柏必須有人回應,我嘅演員就出場喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不久,他的提斯柏必須有人回應,我的演員就出場了。

passages.original: When they him spy, As wild geese that the creeping fowler eye, Or russet-pated choughs, many in sort, Rising and cawing at the gun’s report, Sever themselves and madly sweep the sky, So at his sight away his fellows fly, And at our stamp, here o’er and o’er one falls;
passages.vernacular: 當佢哋睇見佢,像野鵝見到爬行嘅獵人,或紅頭嘅穴烏一大群,喺槍響時飛起鴉叫,四散並瘋狂地掠過天空,佢嘅同伴哋一見佢就咁樣逃走,喺我哋跺腳時,一個接一個喺呢度跌倒;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 當他們看見他,像野鵝見到爬行的獵人,或紅頭的穴烏一大群,在槍響時飛起鴉叫,四散並瘋狂地掠過天空,他的同伴們一見他就這樣逃走,在我們跺腳時,一個接一個在這裡跌倒;

passages.original: He murder cries, and help from Athens calls.
passages.vernacular: 佢喊殺人,從雅典呼救。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他喊殺人,從雅典呼救。

passages.original: Their sense thus weak, lost with their fears, thus strong, Made senseless things begin to do them wrong;
passages.vernacular: 佢哋咁樣微弱嘅理智,被咁樣強烈嘅恐懼所失去,使無知覺嘅嘢開始傷害佢哋;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他們這樣微弱的理智,被這樣強烈的恐懼所失去,使無知覺的東西開始傷害他們;

passages.original: For briers and thorns at their apparel snatch;
passages.vernacular: 因為荊棘同刺鉤住佢哋嘅衣服;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 因為荊棘和刺鉤住他們的衣服;

passages.original: Some sleeves, some hats, from yielders all things catch.
passages.vernacular: 有嘅袖子,有嘅帽子,對屈服嘅人乜嘢都抓。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有的袖子,有的帽子,對屈服的人什麼都抓。

passages.original: I led them on in this distracted fear, And left sweet Pyramus translated there.
passages.vernacular: 我領佢哋喺呢種瘋狂嘅恐懼中前行,把甜蜜嘅皮拉姆斯被轉化嘅樣子留喺嗰度。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我領他們在這種瘋狂的恐懼中前行,把甜蜜的皮拉姆斯被轉化的樣子留在那裡。

passages.original: When in that moment, so it came to pass, Titania wak’d, and straightway lov’d an ass.
passages.vernacular: 就喺嗰時,事情咁樣發生:蒂塔妮婭醒喇,即刻愛上一頭驢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就在那時,事情這樣發生:蒂塔妮婭醒了,立刻愛上一頭驢。

passages.title: Oberon 奧布朗
passages.original: This falls out better than I could devise.
passages.vernacular: 呢比我所能設想嘅更好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這比我所能設想的更好。

passages.original: But hast thou yet latch’d the Athenian’s eyes With the love-juice, as I did bid thee do?
passages.vernacular: 但你已用愛情汁液抹咗嗰個雅典人嘅眼睛,照我吩咐嘅嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但你已用愛情汁液抹了那個雅典人的眼睛,照我吩咐的嗎?

passages.title: Puck 帕克
passages.original: I took him sleeping—that is finish’d too— And the Athenian woman by his side, That, when he wak’d, of force she must be ey’d.
passages.vernacular: 我喺佢瞓住時抹喇——呢都完成喇——仲有佢身邊嘅雅典女人,所以佢醒嚟時,佢必定會被佢睇見。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我在他睡著時抹了——這也完成了——還有他身邊的雅典女人,所以他醒來時,她必定會被他看見。

passages.original: Enter Demetrius and Hermia.
passages.vernacular: [狄米特律斯同赫米婭上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [狄米特律斯與赫米婭上。]

passages.title: Oberon 奧布朗
passages.original: Stand close.
passages.vernacular: 站近些。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 站近些。

passages.original: This is the same Athenian.
passages.vernacular: 呢個就係嗰個雅典人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這就是那個雅典人。

passages.title: Puck 帕克
passages.original: This is the woman, but not this the man.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係嗰個女人,但呢唔係嗰個男人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是那個女人,但這不是那個男人。

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: O why rebuke you him that loves you so?
passages.vernacular: 啊,你為何斥責一個咁樣愛你嘅人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,你為何斥責一個這樣愛你的人?

passages.original: Lay breath so bitter on your bitter foe.
passages.vernacular: 把咁苦嘅氣息吹畀你苦澀嘅仇人吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把這麼苦的氣息吹給你苦澀的仇人吧。

passages.title: Hermia 赫米婭
passages.original: Now I but chide, but I should use thee worse, For thou, I fear, hast given me cause to curse.
passages.vernacular: 而家我只係責罵,但我應對你更糟,因為你,我怕,已畀咗我詛咒嘅理由。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在我只是責罵,但我應對你更糟,因為你,我怕,已給了我詛咒的理由。

passages.original: If thou hast slain Lysander in his sleep, Being o’er shoes in blood, plunge in the deep, And kill me too.
passages.vernacular: 如果你喺拉山德瞓住時殺咗佢,鞋子都淹喺血裡,就跳進深處,把我都殺喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你在拉山德睡著時殺了他,鞋子都淹在血裡,就跳進深處,把我也殺了。

passages.original: The sun was not so true unto the day As he to me.
passages.vernacular: 太陽對白天都不如佢對我忠實。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 太陽對白天也不如他對我忠實。

passages.original: Would he have stol’n away From sleeping Hermia?
passages.vernacular: 佢會偷偷離開瞓住嘅赫米婭嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他會偷偷離開睡著的赫米婭嗎?

passages.original: I’ll believe as soon This whole earth may be bor’d, and that the moon May through the centre creep and so displease Her brother’s noontide with th’ Antipodes.
passages.vernacular: 我寧可相信整個大地可以被鑽穿,月亮可以穿過地心,喺對蹠地嘅人嘅正午打擾佢哥哥(太陽)。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我寧可相信整個大地可以被鑽穿,月亮可以穿過地心,在對蹠地的人的正午打擾她哥哥(太陽)。

passages.original: It cannot be but thou hast murder’d him.
passages.vernacular: 呢唔可能唔係你殺咗佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這不可能不是你殺了他。

passages.original: So should a murderer look, so dead, so grim.
passages.vernacular: 殺人者就該咁樣睇起嚟,咁樣死寂、咁樣嚴峻。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 殺人者就該這樣看起來,這樣死寂、這樣嚴峻。

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: So should the murder’d look, and so should I, Pierc’d through the heart with your stern cruelty.
passages.vernacular: 被殺嘅就該咁樣,我都該咁樣,被你嚴酷嘅殘忍刺穿咗心。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 被殺的就該這樣,我也該這樣,被你嚴酷的殘忍刺穿了心。

passages.original: Yet you, the murderer, look as bright, as clear, As yonder Venus in her glimmering sphere.
passages.vernacular: 然而你,殺人者,睇起嚟咁樣明亮、咁樣清澈,像嗰邊閃爍天球上嘅金星。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 然而你,殺人者,看起來這樣明亮、這樣清澈,像那邊閃爍天球上的金星。

passages.title: Hermia 赫米婭
passages.original: What’s this to my Lysander?
passages.vernacular: 呢跟我嘅拉山德有乜嘢關係?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這跟我的拉山德有什麼關係?

passages.original: Where is he?
passages.vernacular: 佢喺邊度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他在哪裡?

passages.original: Ah, good Demetrius, wilt thou give him me?
passages.vernacular: 啊,好狄米特律斯,你肯把佢還畀我嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,好狄米特律斯,你肯把他還給我嗎?

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: I had rather give his carcass to my hounds.
passages.vernacular: 我寧願把佢嘅屍體畀我嘅獵犬。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我寧願把他的屍體給我的獵犬。

passages.title: Hermia 赫米婭
passages.original: Out, dog! Out, cur!
passages.vernacular: 滾,狗!滾,雜種!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 滾,狗!滾,雜種!

passages.original: Thou driv’st me past the bounds Of maiden’s patience.
passages.vernacular: 你把我逼過咗少女耐心嘅界限。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你把我逼過了少女耐心的界限。

passages.original: Hast thou slain him, then?
passages.vernacular: 咁你殺咗佢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼你殺了他?

passages.original: Henceforth be never number’d among men!
passages.vernacular: 從今以後永遠別被算喺人類之中!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 從今以後永遠別被算在人類之中!

passages.original: O once tell true; tell true, even for my sake!
passages.vernacular: 啊,講一次真話;講真話,邊怕為了我!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,說一次真話;說真話,哪怕為了我!

passages.original: Durst thou have look’d upon him, being awake, And hast thou kill’d him sleeping?
passages.vernacular: 你敢喺佢醒住時睇佢一眼嗎?你竟喺佢瞓住時殺咗佢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你敢在他醒著時看他一眼嗎?你竟在他睡著時殺了他?

passages.original: O brave touch!
passages.vernacular: 啊,好手段!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,好手段!

passages.original: Could not a worm, an adder, do so much?
passages.vernacular: 一條蟲、一條毒蛇,就唔能夠做咁多嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一條蟲、一條毒蛇,就不能做這麼多嗎?

passages.original: An adder did it; for with doubler tongue Than thine, thou serpent, never adder stung.
passages.vernacular: 係毒蛇幹嘅;因為,你呢條蛇,毒蛇嘅舌頭都冇你嘅雙倍歹毒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是毒蛇幹的;因為,你這條蛇,毒蛇的舌頭也沒有你的雙倍歹毒。

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: You spend your passion on a mispris’d mood: I am not guilty of Lysander’s blood;
passages.vernacular: 你把你嘅激情花喺誤解嘅心情上:我冇犯拉山德之血嘅罪;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你把你的激情花在誤解的心情上:我沒有犯拉山德之血的罪;

passages.original: Nor is he dead, for aught that I can tell.
passages.vernacular: 就我所知,佢都冇死。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就我所知,他也沒死。

passages.title: Hermia 赫米婭
passages.original: I pray thee, tell me then that he is well.
passages.vernacular: 嗰求你告訴我佢安好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那求你告訴我他安好。

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: And if I could, what should I get therefore?
passages.vernacular: 如果我能,我會得到乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果我能,我會得到什麼?

passages.title: Hermia 赫米婭
passages.original: A privilege never to see me more.
passages.vernacular: 一項永遠見唔到我嘅特權。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一項永遠見不到我的特權。

passages.original: And from thy hated presence part I so: See me no more, whether he be dead or no.
passages.vernacular: 我就咁樣離開你可恨嘅面前:唔好再見我,不論佢死冇死。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我就這樣離開你可恨的面前:別再見我,不論他死沒死。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: There is no following her in this fierce vein.
passages.vernacular: 喺呢種凶猛嘅情緒下追佢係冇用嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在這種凶猛的情緒下追她是沒用的。

passages.original: Here, therefore, for a while I will remain.
passages.vernacular: 所以,我要喺呢度暫留一會兒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 所以,我要在這裡暫留一會兒。

passages.original: So sorrow’s heaviness doth heavier grow For debt that bankrupt sleep doth sorrow owe;
passages.vernacular: 悲傷嘅沉重因破產嘅瞓眠欠悲傷嘅債而變得更沉重;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 悲傷的沉重因破產的睡眠欠悲傷的債而變得更沉重;

passages.original: Which now in some slight measure it will pay, If for his tender here I make some stay.
passages.vernacular: 而家佢會償還一小部分,如果我喺呢度為佢嘅招標停留一下。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在它會償還一小部分,如果我在這裡為它的招標停留一下。

passages.original: [Lies down.]
passages.vernacular: [躺下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [躺下。]

passages.title: Oberon 奧布朗
passages.original: What hast thou done?
passages.vernacular: 你做咗乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你做了什麼?

passages.original: Thou hast mistaken quite, And laid the love-juice on some true-love’s sight.
passages.vernacular: 你完全弄錯喇,把愛情汁液塗喺某個真愛者嘅眼睛上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你完全弄錯了,把愛情汁液塗在某個真愛者的眼睛上。

passages.original: Of thy misprision must perforce ensue Some true love turn’d, and not a false turn’d true.
passages.vernacular: 因你嘅錯誤,必然導致某個真愛被轉變,而唔係一個假愛轉成真。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 因你的錯誤,必然導致某個真愛被轉變,而不是一個假愛轉成真。

passages.title: Puck 帕克
passages.original: Then fate o’er-rules, that, one man holding troth, A million fail, confounding oath on oath.
passages.vernacular: 咁命運統治,一個人守信,百萬人失信,誓言壓倒誓言。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼命運統治,一個人守信,百萬人失信,誓言壓倒誓言。

passages.title: Oberon 奧布朗
passages.original: About the wood go swifter than the wind, And Helena of Athens look thou find.
passages.vernacular: 你比風更快地跑遍樹林,去找雅典嘅海倫娜。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你比風更快地跑遍樹林,去找雅典的海倫娜。

passages.original: All fancy-sick she is, and pale of cheer With sighs of love, that costs the fresh blood dear.
passages.vernacular: 佢完全因幻想而病,臉色蒼白,嘆息住愛情,嗰耗損鮮血好貴。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她完全因幻想而病,臉色蒼白,嘆息著愛情,那耗損鮮血很貴。

passages.original: By some illusion see thou bring her here; I’ll charm his eyes against she do appear.
passages.vernacular: 用某種幻象把佢帶到呢度;我會喺佢出現前畀佢嘅眼睛施法。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 用某種幻象把她帶到這裡;我會在她出現前給他的眼睛施法。

passages.title: Puck 帕克
passages.original: I go, I go; look how I go, Swifter than arrow from the Tartar’s bow.
passages.vernacular: 我去,我去;睇我點去,比韃靼人弓上嘅箭仲快。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我去,我去;看我怎麼去,比韃靼人弓上的箭還快。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Oberon 奧布朗
passages.original: Flower of this purple dye, Hit with Cupid’s archery, Sink in apple of his eye.
passages.vernacular: 呢紫色染就嘅花,被丘比特嘅箭射中,沉入佢眼珠。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這紫色染就的花,被丘比特的箭射中,沉入他眼珠。

passages.original: When his love he doth espy, Let her shine as gloriously As the Venus of the sky.— When thou wak’st, if she be by, Beg of her for remedy.
passages.vernacular: 當佢睇見佢嘅愛人,讓佢像天上嘅維納斯一樣光輝閃耀。——當你醒嚟,若佢喺旁,向佢求補救。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 當他看見他的愛人,讓她像天上的維納斯一樣光輝閃耀。——當你醒來,若她在旁,向她求補救。

passages.original: Enter Puck.
passages.vernacular: [帕克上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [帕克上。]

passages.title: Puck 帕克
passages.original: Captain of our fairy band, Helena is here at hand, And the youth mistook by me, Pleading for a lover’s fee.
passages.vernacular: 我哋仙隊嘅隊長,海倫娜就喺附近,仲有被我弄錯嘅嗰個青年,正在求一個戀人嘅報償。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們仙隊的隊長,海倫娜就在附近,還有被我弄錯的那個青年,正在求一個戀人的報償。

passages.original: Shall we their fond pageant see?
passages.vernacular: 我哋要唔好睇佢哋愚蠢嘅表演?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們要不要看他們愚蠢的表演?

passages.original: Lord, what fools these mortals be!
passages.vernacular: 主啊,呢啲凡人真係傻瓜!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 主啊,這些凡人真是傻瓜!

passages.title: Oberon 奧布朗
passages.original: Stand aside.
passages.vernacular: 站到一邊。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 站到一邊。

passages.original: The noise they make Will cause Demetrius to awake.
passages.vernacular: 佢哋發出嘅聲音會使狄米特律斯醒嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他們發出的聲音會使狄米特律斯醒來。

passages.title: Puck 帕克
passages.original: Then will two at once woo one.
passages.vernacular: 嗰時兩個人會同時追求一個。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那時兩個人會同時追求一個。

passages.original: That must needs be sport alone; And those things do best please me That befall prepost’rously.
passages.vernacular: 嗰一定係絕妙嘅遊戲;而嗰啲顛倒發生嘅事最使我高興。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那一定是絕妙的遊戲;而那些顛倒發生的事最使我高興。

passages.original: Enter Lysander and Helena.
passages.vernacular: [拉山德同海倫娜上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [拉山德與海倫娜上。]

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: Why should you think that I should woo in scorn?
passages.vernacular: 你點解認為我係帶住輕蔑嚟求愛?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你為什麼認為我是帶著輕蔑來求愛?

passages.original: Scorn and derision never come in tears.
passages.vernacular: 輕蔑同嘲笑從不伴住眼淚而嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 輕蔑和嘲笑從不伴著眼淚而來。

passages.original: Look when I vow, I weep; and vows so born, In their nativity all truth appears.
passages.vernacular: 睇,我發誓時我哭喇;咁樣出生嘅誓言,喺佢誕生時就顯現全部真實。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看,我發誓時我哭了;這樣出生的誓言,在它誕生時就顯現全部真實。

passages.original: How can these things in me seem scorn to you, Bearing the badge of faith, to prove them true?
passages.vernacular: 呢啲喺我身上點可能喺你睇來係輕蔑,既然帶住忠誠嘅標記嚟證明佢哋為真?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這些在我身上怎麼可能在你看來是輕蔑,既然帶著忠誠的標記來證明它們為真?

passages.title: Helena 海倫娜
passages.original: You do advance your cunning more and more.
passages.vernacular: 你越嚟越高明地炫耀你嘅狡猾。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你越來越高明地炫耀你的狡猾。

passages.original: When truth kills truth, O devilish-holy fray!
passages.vernacular: 當真理殺死真理,啊,魔鬼般神聖嘅爭鬥!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 當真理殺死真理,啊,魔鬼般神聖的爭鬥!

passages.original: These vows are Hermia’s: will you give her o’er?
passages.vernacular: 呢啲誓言係赫米婭嘅:你要拋棄佢嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這些誓言是赫米婭的:你要拋棄她嗎?

passages.original: Weigh oath with oath, and you will nothing weigh:
passages.vernacular: 把誓言同誓言稱一稱,你乜嘢都稱不出:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把誓言與誓言稱一稱,你什麼也稱不出:

passages.original: Your vows to her and me, put in two scales, Will even weigh;
passages.vernacular: 你對佢同對我嘅誓言,放喺兩個秤盤上,會同樣重;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你對她和對我的誓言,放在兩個秤盤上,會同樣重;

passages.original: and both as light as tales.
passages.vernacular: 而且兩者都輕如謊話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 而且兩者都輕如謊話。

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: I had no judgment when to her I swore.
passages.vernacular: 我向佢發誓時冇判斷力。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我向她發誓時沒有判斷力。

passages.title: Helena 海倫娜
passages.original: Nor none, in my mind, now you give her o’er.
passages.vernacular: 依我睇,而家你拋棄佢都冇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 依我看,現在你拋棄她也沒有。

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: Demetrius loves her, and he loves not you.
passages.vernacular: 狄米特律斯愛佢,不愛你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 狄米特律斯愛她,不愛你。

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: [Waking.]
passages.vernacular: [醒嚟。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [醒來。]

passages.original: O Helen, goddess, nymph, perfect, divine!
passages.vernacular: 啊海倫,女神,仙女,完美,神聖!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊海倫,女神,仙女,完美,神聖!

passages.original: To what, my love, shall I compare thine eyne?
passages.vernacular: 我嘅愛人,我攞乜嘢嚟比你嘅眼睛?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的愛人,我拿什麼來比你的眼睛?

passages.original: Crystal is muddy.
passages.vernacular: 水晶係渾濁嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 水晶是渾濁的。

passages.original: O how ripe in show Thy lips, those kissing cherries, tempting grow!
passages.vernacular: 啊你嘅嘴唇,嗰啲親吻嘅櫻桃,睇起嚟幾咁成熟,誘人生長!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊你的嘴唇,那些親吻的櫻桃,看起來多麼成熟,誘人生長!

passages.original: That pure congealèd white, high Taurus’ snow, Fann’d with the eastern wind, turns to a crow When thou hold’st up thy hand.
passages.vernacular: 嗰純潔凝結嘅白色,高聳嘅陶魯斯山嘅雪,被東風吹拂,當你舉起手時,就變成烏鴉般黑。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那純潔凝結的白色,高聳的陶魯斯山的雪,被東風吹拂,當你舉起手時,就變成烏鴉般黑。

passages.original: O, let me kiss This princess of pure white, this seal of bliss!
passages.vernacular: 啊,讓我吻呢純白嘅公主,呢幸福嘅印章!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,讓我吻這純白的公主,這幸福的印章!

passages.title: Helena 海倫娜
passages.original: O spite! O hell!
passages.vernacular: 啊惡意!啊地獄!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊惡意!啊地獄!

passages.original: I see you all are bent To set against me for your merriment.
passages.vernacular: 我睇出你哋都一心要聯手對付我,尋你哋嘅開心。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我看出你們都一心要聯手對付我,尋你們的開心。

passages.original: If you were civil, and knew courtesy, You would not do me thus much injury.
passages.vernacular: 如果你哋係文明嘅,懂得禮貌,你哋就唔會對我做咁大嘅傷害。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你們是文明的,懂得禮貌,你們就不會對我做這麼大的傷害。

passages.original: Can you not hate me, as I know you do, But you must join in souls to mock me too?
passages.vernacular: 你哋唔能夠恨我,像我知道你哋恨我嗰樣,卻仲必須聯合起嚟都嘲笑我嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們不能恨我,像我知道你們恨我那樣,卻還必須聯合起來也嘲笑我嗎?

passages.original: If you were men, as men you are in show, You would not use a gentle lady so;
passages.vernacular: 如果你哋係男人,正如你哋外表上係嘅,你哋就唔會咁樣對待一位溫柔嘅小姐;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你們是男人,正如你們外表上是的,你們就不會這樣對待一位溫柔的小姐;

passages.original: To vow, and swear, and superpraise my parts, When I am sure you hate me with your hearts.
passages.vernacular: 發誓、起誓、過度讚美我嘅優點,當我確定你哋心裡恨我嘅時候。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 發誓、起誓、過度讚美我的優點,當我確定你們心裡恨我的時候。

passages.original: You both are rivals, and love Hermia; And now both rivals, to mock Helena.
passages.vernacular: 你哋兩個係情敵,都愛赫米婭;而家兩個情敵,一同嘲笑海倫娜。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們兩個是情敵,都愛赫米婭;現在兩個情敵,一同嘲笑海倫娜。

passages.original: A trim exploit, a manly enterprise, To conjure tears up in a poor maid’s eyes With your derision!
passages.vernacular: 好一個俐落嘅壯舉,一件男子漢嘅事業,用你哋嘅嘲笑喺一個可憐少女嘅眼中引出眼淚!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好一個俐落的壯舉,一件男子漢的事業,用你們的嘲笑在一個可憐少女的眼中引出眼淚!

passages.original: None of noble sort Would so offend a virgin, and extort A poor soul’s patience, all to make you sport.
passages.vernacular: 冇任何高貴嘅人會咁樣冒犯一個處女,並榨取一個可憐靈魂嘅耐心,全為了畀你哋取樂。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有任何高貴的人會這樣冒犯一個處女,並榨取一個可憐靈魂的耐心,全為了給你們取樂。

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: You are unkind, Demetrius; be not so, For you love Hermia; this you know I know.
passages.vernacular: 你太不仁慈喇,狄米特律斯;別咁樣,因為你愛赫米婭;呢個你知道我知道。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你太不仁慈了,狄米特律斯;別這樣,因為你愛赫米婭;這個你知道我知道。

passages.original: And here, with all good will, with all my heart, In Hermia’s love I yield you up my part;
passages.vernacular: 而喺呢度,我以全部善意、全部心,喺赫米婭嘅愛上讓出我嘅嗰份;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 而在這裡,我以全部善意、全部心,在赫米婭的愛上讓出我的那份;

passages.original: And yours of Helena to me bequeath, Whom I do love and will do till my death.
passages.vernacular: 並把你喺海倫娜嗰份遺贈畀我,我愛佢,並將愛到我死。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 並把你在海倫娜那份遺贈給我,我愛她,並將愛到我死。

passages.title: Helena 海倫娜
passages.original: Never did mockers waste more idle breath.
passages.vernacular: 從冇嘲笑者浪費過更多嘅閒氣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 從沒有嘲笑者浪費過更多的閒氣。

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: Lysander, keep thy Hermia; I will none.
passages.vernacular: 拉山德,保住你嘅赫米婭;我唔好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 拉山德,保住你的赫米婭;我不要。

passages.original: If e’er I lov’d her, all that love is gone.
passages.vernacular: 如果我曾愛過佢,嗰所有嘅愛都已消失。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果我曾愛過她,那所有的愛都已消失。

passages.original: My heart to her but as guest-wise sojourn’d; And now to Helen is it home return’d, There to remain.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅心對佢只係作客逗留;而家佢已回到海倫身邊嘅家,留喺嗰度。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的心對她只是作客逗留;現在它已回到海倫身邊的家,留在那裡。

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: Helen, it is not so.
passages.vernacular: 海倫,唔係咁樣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 海倫,不是這樣。

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: Disparage not the faith thou dost not know, Lest to thy peril thou aby it dear.
passages.vernacular: 唔好貶低你不了解嘅忠誠,免得你冒險為之付出昂貴代價。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不要貶低你不了解的忠誠,免得你冒險為之付出昂貴代價。

passages.original: Look where thy love comes; yonder is thy dear.
passages.vernacular: 睇你嘅愛人嚟喇;嗰邊就係你嘅愛人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看你的愛人來了;那邊就是你的愛人。

passages.original: Enter Hermia.
passages.vernacular: [赫米婭上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [赫米婭上。]

passages.title: Hermia 赫米婭
passages.original: Dark night, that from the eye his function takes, The ear more quick of apprehension makes;
passages.vernacular: 黑夜剝奪眼睛嘅功能,卻使耳朵領悟得更快;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 黑夜剝奪眼睛的功能,卻使耳朵領悟得更快;

passages.original: Wherein it doth impair the seeing sense, It pays the hearing double recompense.
passages.vernacular: 喺損害視覺嘅同時,佢對聽覺作出雙倍補償。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在損害視覺的同時,它對聽覺作出雙倍補償。

passages.original: Thou art not by mine eye, Lysander, found; Mine ear, I thank it, brought me to thy sound.
passages.vernacular: 拉山德,唔係我嘅眼睛找到你;我嘅耳朵,感謝佢,帶我找到你嘅聲音。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 拉山德,不是我的眼睛找到你;我的耳朵,感謝它,帶我找到你的聲音。

passages.original: But why unkindly didst thou leave me so?
passages.vernacular: 但你點解嗰樣不仁慈地離開我?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但你為什麼那樣不仁慈地離開我?

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: Why should he stay whom love doth press to go?
passages.vernacular: 被愛催促去走嘅人,點解要留下?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 被愛催促去走的人,為什麼要留下?

passages.title: Hermia 赫米婭
passages.original: What love could press Lysander from my side?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢愛能催促拉山德離開我身邊?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼愛能催促拉山德離開我身邊?

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: Lysander’s love, that would not let him bide, Fair Helena, who more engilds the night Than all yon fiery oes and eyes of light.
passages.vernacular: 拉山德嘅愛,唔容佢留下,美麗嘅海倫娜,佢比嗰邊所有火焰般嘅圓環同光之眼更使夜晚鍍金。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 拉山德的愛,不容他留下,美麗的海倫娜,她比那邊所有火焰般的圓環和光之眼更使夜晚鍍金。

passages.original: Why seek’st thou me?
passages.vernacular: 你點解找我?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你為什麼找我?

passages.original: Could not this make thee know The hate I bare thee made me leave thee so?
passages.vernacular: 難道呢唔能夠讓你知道,我對你嘅恨使我咁樣離開你嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 難道這不能讓你知道,我對你的恨使我這樣離開你嗎?

passages.title: Hermia 赫米婭
passages.original: You speak not as you think; it cannot be.
passages.vernacular: 你講嘅唔係你想嘅;唔可能。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你說的不是你想的;不可能。

passages.title: Helena 海倫娜
passages.original: Lo, she is one of this confederacy!
passages.vernacular: 睇,佢係呢夥人之一!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看,她是這夥人之一!

passages.original: Now I perceive they have conjoin’d all three To fashion this false sport in spite of me.
passages.vernacular: 而家我睇出佢哋三個聯手,設計呢場假戲嚟對付我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在我看出他們三個聯手,設計這場假戲來對付我。

passages.original: Injurious Hermia, most ungrateful maid!
passages.vernacular: 傷人嘅赫米婭,最忘恩嘅少女!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 傷人的赫米婭,最忘恩的少女!

passages.original: Have you conspir’d, have you with these contriv’d, To bait me with this foul derision?
passages.vernacular: 你已合謀,你已同呢啲人策劃,用呢可恥嘅嘲笑嚟戲弄我嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你已合謀,你已和這些人策劃,用這可恥的嘲笑來戲弄我嗎?

passages.original: Is all the counsel that we two have shar’d, The sisters’ vows, the hours that we have spent, When we have chid the hasty-footed time For parting us—O, is all forgot?
passages.vernacular: 我哋兩人分享嘅全部知心話,姊妹般嘅誓言,我哋一起度過嘅時光,當我哋責備腳步匆匆嘅時間要把我哋分開——啊,全都忘咗嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們兩人分享的全部知心話,姊妹般的誓言,我們一起度過的時光,當我們責備腳步匆匆的時間要把我們分開——啊,全都忘了嗎?

passages.original: All school-days’ friendship, childhood innocence?
passages.vernacular: 學生時代嘅友誼,童年嘅純真?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 學生時代的友誼,童年的純真?

passages.original: We, Hermia, like two artificial gods, Have with our needles created both one flower, Both on one sampler, sitting on one cushion, Both warbling of one song, both in one key, As if our hands, our sides, voices, and minds, Had been incorporate.
passages.vernacular: 我哋,赫米婭,像兩個人造嘅神,用我哋嘅針線創造咗同一朵花,同喺一塊刺繡樣布上,坐喺同一個墊子上,同唱一首歌,同喺一個調上,彷彿我哋嘅手、身側、聲音同心思,都合為一體。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們,赫米婭,像兩個人造的神,用我們的針線創造了同一朵花,同在一塊刺繡樣布上,坐在同一個墊子上,同唱一首歌,同在一個調上,彷彿我們的手、身側、聲音和心思,都合為一體。

passages.original: So we grew together, Like to a double cherry, seeming parted, But yet a union in partition, Two lovely berries moulded on one stem;
passages.vernacular: 我哋就咁樣一起長大,像一對雙櫻桃,睇似分開,卻喺分開中合一,兩顆可愛嘅果子長喺同一根莖上;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們就這樣一起長大,像一對雙櫻桃,看似分開,卻在分開中合一,兩顆可愛的果子長在同一根莖上;

passages.original: So, with two seeming bodies, but one heart; Two of the first, like coats in heraldry, Due but to one, and crownèd with one crest.
passages.vernacular: 所以,有兩個睇似嘅身體,卻只有一顆心;兩個最初嘅,像紋章中嘅盾徽,只屬於一個,並戴住同一個冠飾。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 所以,有兩個看似的身體,卻只有一顆心;兩個最初的,像紋章中的盾徽,只屬於一個,並戴著同一個冠飾。

passages.original: And will you rent our ancient love asunder, To join with men in scorning your poor friend?
passages.vernacular: 你要把我哋古老嘅愛情撕開,同男人一起嘲笑你可憐嘅朋友嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你要把我們古老的愛情撕開,與男人一起嘲笑你可憐的朋友嗎?

passages.original: It is not friendly, ’tis not maidenly.
passages.vernacular: 呢不友善,呢唔係少女該做嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這不友善,這不是少女該做的。

passages.original: Our sex, as well as I, may chide you for it, Though I alone do feel the injury.
passages.vernacular: 我哋嘅性別,同我一樣,可以為此責備你,雖然只有我感受到傷害。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們的性別,和我一樣,可以為此責備你,雖然只有我感受到傷害。

passages.title: Hermia 赫米婭
passages.original: I am amazèd at your passionate words: I scorn you not;
passages.vernacular: 我對你激動嘅話感到驚訝:我冇嘲笑你;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我對你激動的話感到驚訝:我沒有嘲笑你;

passages.original: it seems that you scorn me.
passages.vernacular: 似乎係你喺嘲笑我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 似乎是你在嘲笑我。

passages.title: Helena 海倫娜
passages.original: Have you not set Lysander, as in scorn, To follow me, and praise my eyes and face?
passages.vernacular: 你唔係讓拉山德,好像出於嘲笑,跟住我,讚美我嘅眼睛同臉嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你不是讓拉山德,好像出於嘲笑,跟著我,讚美我的眼睛和臉嗎?

passages.original: And made your other love, Demetrius, Who even but now did spurn me with his foot, To call me goddess, nymph, divine and rare, Precious, celestial?
passages.vernacular: 並讓你嘅另一個愛人狄米特律斯,佢剛頭先用腳踢開我,叫我女神、仙女、神聖同稀有、珍貴、天上嘅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 並讓你的另一個愛人狄米特律斯,他剛剛才用腳踢開我,叫我女神、仙女、神聖和稀有、珍貴、天上的?

passages.original: Wherefore speaks he this To her he hates?
passages.vernacular: 佢點解對佢恨嘅人講呢啲?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他為什麼對他恨的人說這些?

passages.original: And wherefore doth Lysander Deny your love, so rich within his soul, And tender me, forsooth, affection, But by your setting on, by your consent?
passages.vernacular: 點解拉山德拒絕你嘅愛,嗰喺佢靈魂裡咁豐富嘅,而講真嘅,向我獻上感情,若唔係由於你嘅唆使、你嘅同意?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為什麼拉山德拒絕你的愛,那在他靈魂裡這麼豐富的,而說真的,向我獻上感情,若不是由於你的唆使、你的同意?

passages.original: What though I be not so in grace as you, So hung upon with love, so fortunate, But miserable most, to love unlov’d?
passages.vernacular: 就算我不像你嗰樣得寵,嗰樣被愛環繞,嗰樣幸運,而係最悲慘嘅,愛住不被愛嘅人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就算我不像你那樣得寵,那樣被愛環繞,那樣幸運,而是最悲慘的,愛著不被愛的人?

passages.original: This you should pity rather than despise.
passages.vernacular: 呢你應該同情而唔係蔑視。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這你應該同情而不是蔑視。

passages.title: Hermia 赫米婭
passages.original: I understand not what you mean by this.
passages.vernacular: 我不明白你呢個係乜嘢意思。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不明白你這是什麼意思。

passages.title: Helena 海倫娜
passages.original: Ay, do.
passages.vernacular: 對,就咁樣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對,就這樣。

passages.original: Persever, counterfeit sad looks, Make mouths upon me when I turn my back, Wink each at other; hold the sweet jest up.
passages.vernacular: 堅持下去,假裝悲傷嘅神情,我轉身時對我做鬼臉,彼此眨眼;把呢甜蜜嘅玩笑繼續下去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 堅持下去,假裝悲傷的神情,我轉身時對我做鬼臉,彼此眨眼;把這甜蜜的玩笑繼續下去。

passages.original: This sport, well carried, shall be chronicled.
passages.vernacular: 呢場遊戲,若演得好,將被載入史冊。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這場遊戲,若演得好,將被載入史冊。

passages.original: If you have any pity, grace, or manners, You would not make me such an argument.
passages.vernacular: 如果你哋有啲憐憫、風度或禮貌,你哋就唔會把我當作咁樣嘅話題。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你們有一點憐憫、風度或禮貌,你們就不會把我當作這樣的話題。

passages.original: But fare ye well.
passages.vernacular: 但再會。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但再會。

passages.original: ’Tis partly my own fault, Which death, or absence, soon shall remedy.
passages.vernacular: 部分係我自己嘅錯,死亡或離別好快會補救佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 部分是我自己的錯,死亡或離別很快會補救它。

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: Stay, gentle Helena; hear my excuse; My love, my life, my soul, fair Helena!
passages.vernacular: 留下,溫柔嘅海倫娜;聽我嘅解釋;我嘅愛,我嘅生命,我嘅靈魂,美麗嘅海倫娜!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 留下,溫柔的海倫娜;聽我的解釋;我的愛,我的生命,我的靈魂,美麗的海倫娜!

passages.title: Helena 海倫娜
passages.original: O excellent!
passages.vernacular: 啊,太棒喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,太棒了!

passages.title: Hermia 赫米婭
passages.original: Sweet, do not scorn her so.
passages.vernacular: 親愛嘅,唔好咁樣嘲笑佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 親愛的,不要這樣嘲笑她。

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: If she cannot entreat, I can compel.
passages.vernacular: 如果佢唔能夠懇求,我能強迫。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果她不能懇求,我能強迫。

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: Thou canst compel no more than she entreat; Thy threats have no more strength than her weak prayers.
passages.vernacular: 你強迫嘅唔會多於佢嘅懇求;你嘅威脅冇比佢軟弱嘅祈禱更強嘅力量。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你強迫的不會多於她的懇求;你的威脅沒有比她軟弱的祈禱更強的力量。

passages.original: Helen, I love thee, by my life I do; I swear by that which I will lose for thee To prove him false that says I love thee not.
passages.vernacular: 海倫,我愛你,我憑我嘅生命發誓,憑我為你願意失去嘅,去證明講我不愛你嘅人係假嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 海倫,我愛你,我憑我的生命發誓,憑我為你願意失去的,去證明說我不愛你的人是假的。

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: I say I love thee more than he can do.
passages.vernacular: 我講我比佢更愛你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我說我比他更愛你。

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: If thou say so, withdraw, and prove it too.
passages.vernacular: 如果你咁講,退後,並證明佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你這麼說,退後,並證明它。

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: Quick, come.
passages.vernacular: 快,嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 快,來。

passages.title: Hermia 赫米婭
passages.original: Lysander, whereto tends all this?
passages.vernacular: 拉山德,呢一切要往邊度去?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 拉山德,這一切要往哪裡去?

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: Away, you Ethiope!
passages.vernacular: 走開,你呢衣索比亞人!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 走開,你這衣索比亞人!

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: No, no.
passages.vernacular: 不,不。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,不。

passages.original: He will Seem to break loose.
passages.vernacular: 佢會假裝掙脫。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他會假裝掙脫。

passages.original: Take on as you would follow, But yet come not.
passages.vernacular: 做出要跟隨嘅樣子,但卻不嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 做出要跟隨的樣子,但卻不來。

passages.original: You are a tame man, go!
passages.vernacular: 你係個馴服嘅人,走開!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你是個馴服的人,走開!

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: Hang off, thou cat, thou burr!
passages.vernacular: 放手,你呢貓,你呢毛刺!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 放手,你這貓,你這毛刺!

passages.original: Vile thing, let loose, Or I will shake thee from me like a serpent.
passages.vernacular: 卑賤嘅嘢,放開,否則我把你像蛇一樣甩開。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 卑賤的東西,放開,否則我把你像蛇一樣甩開。

passages.title: Hermia 赫米婭
passages.original: Why are you grown so rude?
passages.vernacular: 你點解變得咁粗魯?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你為什麼變得這麼粗魯?

passages.original: What change is this, Sweet love?
passages.vernacular: 呢個係乜嘢變化,親愛嘅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是什麼變化,親愛的?

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: Thy love?
passages.vernacular: 你嘅「親愛」?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你的「親愛」?

passages.original: Out, tawny Tartar, out!
passages.vernacular: 滾,黝黑嘅韃靼人,滾!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 滾,黝黑的韃靼人,滾!

passages.original: Out, loathèd medicine!
passages.vernacular: 滾,可憎嘅藥!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 滾,可憎的藥!

passages.original: O hated potion, hence!
passages.vernacular: 啊可恨嘅藥水,走開!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊可恨的藥水,走開!

passages.title: Hermia 赫米婭
passages.original: Do you not jest?
passages.vernacular: 你唔係喺開玩笑吧?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你不是在開玩笑吧?

passages.title: Helena 海倫娜
passages.original: Yes, sooth, and so do you.
passages.vernacular: 係,講真嘅,你都係。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,說真的,你也是。

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: Demetrius, I will keep my word with thee.
passages.vernacular: 狄米特律斯,我會對你守約。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 狄米特律斯,我會對你守約。

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: I would I had your bond; for I perceive A weak bond holds you;
passages.vernacular: 我但願有你嘅契約;因為我睇出一份脆弱嘅契約束縛住你;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我但願有你的契約;因為我看出一份脆弱的契約束縛著你;

passages.original: I’ll not trust your word.
passages.vernacular: 我不信你嘅話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不信你的話。

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: What, should I hurt her, strike her, kill her dead?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,我該傷害佢,打佢,把佢殺死嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,我該傷害她,打她,把她殺死嗎?

passages.original: Although I hate her, I’ll not harm her so.
passages.vernacular: 雖然我恨佢,我都唔會咁樣傷害佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 雖然我恨她,我也不會這樣傷害她。

passages.title: Hermia 赫米婭
passages.original: What, can you do me greater harm than hate? Hate me? Wherefore? O me!
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,你仲能對我造成比恨更大嘅傷害嗎?恨我?點解?哎呀!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,你還能對我造成比恨更大的傷害嗎?恨我?為什麼?哎呀!

passages.original: what news, my love?
passages.vernacular: 有乜嘢消息,我嘅愛?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有什麼消息,我的愛?

passages.original: Am not I Hermia?
passages.vernacular: 我唔係赫米婭嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不是赫米婭嗎?

passages.original: Are not you Lysander?
passages.vernacular: 你唔係拉山德嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你不是拉山德嗎?

passages.original: I am as fair now as I was erewhile.
passages.vernacular: 我而家同頭先一樣美。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我現在和剛才一樣美。

passages.original: Since night you lov’d me; yet since night you left me.
passages.vernacular: 昨夜你仲愛我;不過昨夜你又離開咗我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 昨夜你還愛我;可是昨夜你又離開了我。

passages.original: Why then, you left me—O, the gods forbid!— In earnest, shall I say?
passages.vernacular: 哎,咁你離開我——啊,諸神禁止!——講真嘅,我該咁樣講嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎,那麼你離開我——啊,諸神禁止!——說真的,我該這樣說嗎?

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: Ay, by my life; And never did desire to see thee more.
passages.vernacular: 對,憑我嘅生命;而且我從唔想再見到你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對,憑我的生命;而且我從不想再見到你。

passages.original: Therefore be out of hope, of question, of doubt;
passages.vernacular: 所以放棄希望、質疑、懷疑;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 所以放棄希望、質疑、懷疑;

passages.original: Be certain, nothing truer; ’tis no jest That I do hate thee and love Helena.
passages.vernacular: 要確定,冇比呢更真嘅喇;呢唔係玩笑,我恨你而愛海倫娜。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 要確定,沒有比這更真的了;這不是玩笑,我恨你而愛海倫娜。

passages.title: Hermia 赫米婭
passages.original: O me!
passages.vernacular: 哎呀!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀!

passages.original: You juggler!
passages.vernacular: 你呢騙子!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你這騙子!

passages.original: You cankerblossom!
passages.vernacular: 你呢蛀花嘅蟲!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你這蛀花的蟲!

passages.original: You thief of love! What!
passages.vernacular: 你呢偷愛情嘅賊!乜嘢!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你這偷愛情的賊!什麼!

passages.original: have you come by night And stol’n my love’s heart from him?
passages.vernacular: 你夜裡嚟,從佢嗰度偷走咗我愛人嘅心嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你夜裡來,從他那裡偷走了我愛人的心嗎?

passages.title: Helena 海倫娜
passages.original: Fine, i’ faith!
passages.vernacular: 好極喇,講真嘅!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好極了,說真的!

passages.original: Have you no modesty, no maiden shame, No touch of bashfulness?
passages.vernacular: 你冇端莊,冇少女嘅羞恥,啲羞澀嘅感覺都冇嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你沒有端莊,沒有少女的羞恥,一點羞澀的感覺都沒有嗎?

passages.original: What, will you tear Impatient answers from my gentle tongue?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,你要從我溫柔嘅舌頭上扯出不耐煩嘅回答嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,你要從我溫柔的舌頭上扯出不耐煩的回答嗎?

passages.original: Fie, fie, you counterfeit, you puppet, you!
passages.vernacular: 呸,呸,你呢假貨,你呢傀儡!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 呸,呸,你這假貨,你這傀儡!

passages.title: Hermia 赫米婭
passages.original: Puppet! Why so?
passages.vernacular: 傀儡!點解咁講?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 傀儡!為什麼這麼說?

passages.original: Ay, that way goes the game.
passages.vernacular: 對,遊戲係往嗰邊去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對,遊戲是往那邊去。

passages.original: Now I perceive that she hath made compare Between our statures;
passages.vernacular: 而家我明白佢攞我哋嘅身高作咗比較;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在我明白她拿我們的身高作了比較;

passages.original: she hath urg’d her height; And with her personage, her tall personage, Her height, forsooth, she hath prevail’d with him.
passages.vernacular: 佢攞出佢嘅高度;憑佢嘅身材,佢嘅高個子,佢嘅高度,真嘅,佢已講服咗佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她拿出她的高度;憑她的身材,她的高個子,她的高度,真的,她已說服了他。

passages.original: And are you grown so high in his esteem Because I am so dwarfish and so low?
passages.vernacular: 難道我咁矮小低微,你就喺佢眼中變得咁高嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 難道我這麼矮小低微,你就在他眼中變得這麼高嗎?

passages.original: How low am I, thou painted maypole?
passages.vernacular: 我多矮,你呢塗咗色嘅五月柱?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我多矮,你這塗了色的五月柱?

passages.original: Speak, How low am I?
passages.vernacular: 講,我多矮?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說,我多矮?

passages.original: I am not yet so low But that my nails can reach unto thine eyes.
passages.vernacular: 我仲冇矮到我嘅指甲夠不住你嘅眼睛。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我還沒矮到我的指甲夠不著你的眼睛。

passages.title: Helena 海倫娜
passages.original: I pray you, though you mock me, gentlemen, Let her not hurt me.
passages.vernacular: 請你哋,先生哋,雖然你哋嘲笑我,唔好畀佢傷害我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你們,先生們,雖然你們嘲笑我,別讓她傷害我。

passages.original: I was never curst; I have no gift at all in shrewishness;
