passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊邪惡的牆,透過你我看不到幸福,願你的石頭被詛咒,這樣欺騙我!

passages.title: Theseus 忒修斯
passages.original: The wall, methinks, being sensible, should curse again.
passages.vernacular: 牆,我想,既然有感覺,應該回罵。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 牆,我想,既然有感覺,應該回罵。

passages.title: Pyramus 皮拉姆斯
passages.original: No, in truth, sir, he should not.
passages.vernacular: 不,講真嘅,先生,佢不該。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,說真的,先生,他不該。

passages.original: ‘Deceiving me’ is Thisbe’s cue: she is to enter now, and I am to spy her through the wall.
passages.vernacular: 「欺騙我」係提斯柏嘅提示:佢而家要出場,我要透過牆睇見佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 「欺騙我」是提斯柏的提示:她現在要出場,我要透過牆看見她。

passages.original: You shall see it will fall pat as I told you.
passages.vernacular: 你會睇到佢正如我所講嘅恰好吻合。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你會看到它正如我所說的恰好吻合。

passages.original: Yonder she comes.
passages.vernacular: 佢嚟喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她來了。

passages.original: Enter Thisbe.
passages.vernacular: [提斯柏上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [提斯柏上。]

passages.title: Thisbe 提斯柏
passages.original: O wall, full often hast thou heard my moans, For parting my fair Pyramus and me.
passages.vernacular: 啊牆,你常聽見我嘅哀嘆,因為你拆散我美麗嘅皮拉姆斯同我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊牆,你常聽見我的哀嘆,因為你拆散我美麗的皮拉姆斯和我。

passages.original: My cherry lips have often kiss’d thy stones, Thy stones with lime and hair knit up in thee.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅櫻桃嘴唇常親吻你嘅石頭,你嘅石頭同石灰同毛髮結合成你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的櫻桃嘴唇常親吻你的石頭,你的石頭與石灰和毛髮結合成你。

passages.title: Pyramus 皮拉姆斯
passages.original: I see a voice; now will I to the chink, To spy an I can hear my Thisbe’s face. Thisbe?
passages.vernacular: 我睇見一個聲音;而家我要到裂縫嗰度,睇我能唔能夠聽見我提斯柏嘅臉。提斯柏?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我看見一個聲音;現在我要到裂縫那裡,看我能不能聽見我提斯柏的臉。提斯柏?

passages.title: Thisbe 提斯柏
passages.original: My love thou art, my love I think.
passages.vernacular: 你係我嘅愛,我想你係我嘅愛。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你是我的愛,我想你是我的愛。

passages.title: Pyramus 皮拉姆斯
passages.original: Think what thou wilt, I am thy lover’s grace;
passages.vernacular: 你愛點想就點想,我係你愛人嘅恩惠;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你愛怎麼想就怎麼想,我是你愛人的恩惠;

passages.original: And like Limander am I trusty still.
passages.vernacular: 像利曼德一樣,我始終忠實。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 像利曼德一樣,我始終忠實。

passages.title: Thisbe 提斯柏
passages.original: And I like Helen, till the fates me kill.
passages.vernacular: 我像海倫,直到命運殺死我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我像海倫,直到命運殺死我。

passages.title: Pyramus 皮拉姆斯
passages.original: Not Shafalus to Procrus was so true.
passages.vernacular: 沙法勒斯對普羅克魯斯都冇咁真。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沙法勒斯對普羅克魯斯也沒這麼真。

passages.title: Thisbe 提斯柏
passages.original: As Shafalus to Procrus, I to you.
passages.vernacular: 如沙法勒斯對普羅克魯斯,我對你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如沙法勒斯對普羅克魯斯,我對你。

passages.title: Pyramus 皮拉姆斯
passages.original: O kiss me through the hole of this vile wall.
passages.vernacular: 啊,透過呢可惡牆嘅洞吻我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,透過這可惡牆的洞吻我。

passages.title: Thisbe 提斯柏
passages.original: I kiss the wall’s hole, not your lips at all.
passages.vernacular: 我吻嘅係牆嘅洞,啲都唔係你嘅嘴唇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我吻的是牆的洞,一點也不是你的嘴唇。

passages.title: Pyramus 皮拉姆斯
passages.original: Wilt thou at Ninny’s tomb meet me straightway?
passages.vernacular: 你願意即刻到尼尼嘅墳墓同我相會嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你願意馬上到尼尼的墳墓與我相會嗎?

passages.title: Thisbe 提斯柏
passages.original: ’Tide life, ’tide death, I come without delay.
passages.vernacular: 不管生死,我毫不遲疑地嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不管生死,我毫不遲疑地來。

passages.title: Wall 牆
passages.original: Thus have I, Wall, my part discharged so; And, being done, thus Wall away doth go.
passages.vernacular: 咁樣,我,牆,把我嘅角色演完喇;既然完成,牆就咁樣走開。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這樣,我,牆,把我的角色演完了;既然完成,牆就這樣走開。

passages.original: [Exeunt Wall, Pyramus and Thisbe.]
passages.vernacular: [牆、皮拉姆斯同提斯柏下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [牆、皮拉姆斯與提斯柏下。]

passages.title: Theseus 忒修斯
passages.original: Now is the mural down between the two neighbours.
passages.vernacular: 而家兩個鄰居之間嘅牆倒喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在兩個鄰居之間的牆倒了。

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: No remedy, my lord, when walls are so wilful to hear without warning.
passages.vernacular: 冇辦法,大人,當牆咁任性地不事先警告就聽。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有辦法,大人,當牆這麼任性地不事先警告就聽。

passages.title: Hippolyta 希波呂忒
passages.original: This is the silliest stuff that ever I heard.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係我聽過最蠢嘅嘢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是我聽過最蠢的東西。

passages.title: Theseus 忒修斯
passages.original: The best in this kind are but shadows; and the worst are no worse, if imagination amend them.
passages.vernacular: 呢類嘢最好嘅都不過係影子;最壞嘅都唔會更壞,只要想像力能補足佢哋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這類東西最好的也不過是影子;最壞的也不會更壞,只要想像力能補足它們。

passages.title: Hippolyta 希波呂忒
passages.original: It must be your imagination then, and not theirs.
passages.vernacular: 嗰一定係你嘅想像力,而唔係佢哋嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那一定是你的想像力,而不是他們的。

passages.title: Theseus 忒修斯
passages.original: If we imagine no worse of them than they of themselves, they may pass for excellent men.
passages.vernacular: 如果我哋對佢哋嘅想像不比佢哋對自己嘅更壞,佢哋可以算係優秀嘅人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果我們對他們的想像不比他們對自己的更壞,他們可以算是優秀的人。

passages.original: Here come two noble beasts in, a man and a lion.
passages.vernacular: 呢度嚟咗兩頭高貴嘅野獸,一個人同一頭獅子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這裡來了兩頭高貴的野獸,一個人和一頭獅子。

passages.original: Enter Lion and Moonshine.
passages.vernacular: [獅子同月光上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [獅子與月光上。]

passages.title: Lion 獅子
passages.original: You, ladies, you, whose gentle hearts do fear The smallest monstrous mouse that creeps on floor, May now, perchance, both quake and tremble here, When lion rough in wildest rage doth roar.
passages.vernacular: 你哋,女士哋,你哋溫柔嘅心害怕地上爬嘅最小怪異老鼠,而家或者會喺呢度既戰慄又顫抖,當粗野嘅獅子喺最狂怒中咆哮。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們,女士們,你們溫柔的心害怕地上爬的最小怪異老鼠,現在也許會在這裡既戰慄又顫抖,當粗野的獅子在最狂怒中咆哮。

passages.original: Then know that I, one Snug the joiner, am A lion fell, nor else no lion’s dam;
passages.vernacular: 咁要知道我係細木工斯納格,係一頭兇猛嘅獅子,而唔係母獅;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼要知道我是細木工斯納格,是一頭兇猛的獅子,而不是母獅;

passages.original: For if I should as lion come in strife Into this place, ’twere pity on my life.
passages.vernacular: 因為如果我以獅子嘅身分喺爭鬥中嚟到呢度,我嘅命就可惜喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 因為如果我以獅子的身分在爭鬥中來到這裡,我的命就可惜了。

passages.title: Theseus 忒修斯
passages.original: A very gentle beast, and of a good conscience.
passages.vernacular: 一頭好溫和、好有良心嘅野獸。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一頭非常溫和、很有良心的野獸。

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: The very best at a beast, my lord, that e’er I saw.
passages.vernacular: 大人,我見過最好嘅野獸。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大人,我見過最好的野獸。

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: This lion is a very fox for his valour.
passages.vernacular: 呢頭獅子喺勇氣上係頭狐狸。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這頭獅子在勇氣上是頭狐狸。

passages.title: Theseus 忒修斯
passages.original: True; and a goose for his discretion.
passages.vernacular: 對;而喺謹慎上係隻鵝。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對;而在謹慎上是隻鵝。

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: Not so, my lord, for his valour cannot carry his discretion, and the fox carries the goose.
passages.vernacular: 唔係咁樣,大人,因為佢嘅勇氣載不動佢嘅謹慎,而狐狸能叼走鵝。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不是這樣,大人,因為他的勇氣載不動他的謹慎,而狐狸能叼走鵝。

passages.title: Theseus 忒修斯
passages.original: His discretion, I am sure, cannot carry his valour;
passages.vernacular: 我確信佢嘅謹慎載不動佢嘅勇氣;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我確信他的謹慎載不動他的勇氣;

passages.original: for the goose carries not the fox.
passages.vernacular: 因為鵝叼不走狐狸。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 因為鵝叼不走狐狸。

passages.original: It is well; leave it to his discretion, and let us listen to the moon.
passages.vernacular: 好吧;把佢留畀佢嘅謹慎,讓我哋聽月亮。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好吧;把它留給他的謹慎,讓我們聽月亮。

passages.title: Moonshine 月光
passages.original: This lanthorn doth the hornèd moon present.
passages.vernacular: 呢盞燈籠代表有角嘅月亮。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這盞燈籠代表有角的月亮。

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: He should have worn the horns on his head.
passages.vernacular: 佢應該把角戴喺頭上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他應該把角戴在頭上。

passages.title: Theseus 忒修斯
passages.original: He is no crescent, and his horns are invisible within the circumference.
passages.vernacular: 佢唔係新月,佢嘅角喺圓周內睇唔見。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他不是新月,他的角在圓周內看不見。

passages.title: Moonshine 月光
passages.original: This lanthorn doth the hornèd moon present; Myself the man i’ the moon do seem to be.
passages.vernacular: 呢盞燈籠代表有角嘅月亮;我自己似乎係月亮裡嘅人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這盞燈籠代表有角的月亮;我自己似乎是月亮裡的人。

passages.title: Theseus 忒修斯
passages.original: This is the greatest error of all the rest; the man should be put into the lantern.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係所有錯誤裡最大嘅;人應該放進燈籠裡。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是所有錯誤裡最大的;人應該放進燈籠裡。

passages.original: How is it else the man i’ the moon?
passages.vernacular: 不然點係月亮裡嘅人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不然怎麼是月亮裡的人?

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: He dares not come there for the candle, for you see, it is already in snuff.
passages.vernacular: 佢唔敢嚟嗰度,因為蠟燭,你哋睇,已經燒焦喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他不敢來那裡,因為蠟燭,你們看,已經燒焦了。

passages.title: Hippolyta 希波呂忒
passages.original: I am aweary of this moon.
passages.vernacular: 我厭倦呢個月亮。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我厭倦這個月亮。

passages.original: Would he would change!
passages.vernacular: 但願佢換掉!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但願他換掉!

passages.title: Theseus 忒修斯
passages.original: It appears by his small light of discretion that he is in the wane;
passages.vernacular: 從佢微小嘅謹慎之光睇,佢喺虧缺;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 從他微小的謹慎之光看,他在虧缺;

passages.original: but yet, in courtesy, in all reason, we must stay the time.
passages.vernacular: 不過出於禮貌,按理我哋得等呢陣候。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不過出於禮貌,按理我們得等這時候。

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: Proceed, Moon.
passages.vernacular: 繼續,月亮。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 繼續,月亮。

passages.title: Moon 月光
passages.original: All that I have to say, is to tell you that the lantern is the moon;
passages.vernacular: 我要講嘅只係告訴你哋,燈籠係月亮;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要說的只是告訴你們,燈籠是月亮;

passages.original: I the man i’ the moon; this thorn-bush my thorn-bush; and this dog my dog.
passages.vernacular: 我係月亮裡嘅人;呢荊棘叢係我嘅荊棘叢;呢狗係我嘅狗。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我是月亮裡的人;這荊棘叢是我的荊棘叢;這狗是我的狗。

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: Why, all these should be in the lantern, for all these are in the moon.
passages.vernacular: 哎,呢啲都該喺燈籠裡,因為呢啲都喺月亮裡。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎,這些都該在燈籠裡,因為這些都在月亮裡。

passages.original: But silence; here comes Thisbe.
passages.vernacular: 但安靜;提斯柏嚟喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但安靜;提斯柏來了。

passages.original: Enter Thisbe.
passages.vernacular: [提斯柏上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [提斯柏上。]

passages.title: Thisbe 提斯柏
passages.original: This is old Ninny’s tomb.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係老尼尼嘅墳墓。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是老尼尼的墳墓。

passages.original: Where is my love?
passages.vernacular: 我嘅愛人喺邊度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的愛人在哪裡?

passages.title: Lion 獅子
passages.original: Oh!
passages.vernacular: 啊!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊!

passages.original: [The Lion roars, Thisbe runs off.]
passages.vernacular: [獅子吼叫,提斯柏跑下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [獅子吼叫,提斯柏跑下。]

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: Well roared, Lion.
passages.vernacular: 吼得好,獅子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 吼得好,獅子。

passages.title: Theseus 忒修斯
passages.original: Well run, Thisbe.
passages.vernacular: 跑得好,提斯柏。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 跑得好,提斯柏。

passages.title: Hippolyta 希波呂忒
passages.original: Well shone, Moon.
passages.vernacular: 照得好,月亮。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 照得好,月亮。

passages.original: Truly, the moon shines with a good grace.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,月亮照得好有風度。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,月亮照得很有風度。

passages.original: [The Lion tears Thisbe’s mantle, and exit.]
passages.vernacular: [獅子撕破提斯柏嘅斗篷,下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [獅子撕破提斯柏的斗篷,下。]

passages.title: Theseus 忒修斯
passages.original: Well moused, Lion.
passages.vernacular: 咬得好,獅子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咬得好,獅子。

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: And then came Pyramus.
passages.vernacular: 然後皮拉姆斯嚟喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 然後皮拉姆斯來了。

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: And so the lion vanished.
passages.vernacular: 咁樣獅子就消失喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這樣獅子就消失了。

passages.original: Enter Pyramus.
passages.vernacular: [皮拉姆斯上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [皮拉姆斯上。]

passages.title: Pyramus 皮拉姆斯
passages.original: Sweet Moon, I thank thee for thy sunny beams;
passages.vernacular: 甜美嘅月亮,我謝你日光般嘅光線;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 甜美的月亮,我謝你日光般的光線;

passages.original: I thank thee, Moon, for shining now so bright;
passages.vernacular: 月亮,我謝你而家照得咁樣明亮;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 月亮,我謝你現在照得這樣明亮;

passages.original: For, by thy gracious golden, glittering gleams, I trust to take of truest Thisbe sight. But stay! O spite!
passages.vernacular: 因為憑你優雅嘅金色閃爍光芒,我相信能睇到最忠實嘅提斯柏。但等一下!啊惡意!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 因為憑你優雅的金色閃爍光芒,我相信能看到最忠實的提斯柏。但等一下!啊惡意!

passages.original: But mark, poor knight, What dreadful dole is here!
passages.vernacular: 但睇,可憐嘅騎士,呢度係點樣嘅可怕悲傷!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但看,可憐的騎士,這裡是怎樣的可怕悲傷!

passages.original: Eyes, do you see?
passages.vernacular: 眼睛,你哋睇見咗嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 眼睛,你們看見了嗎?

passages.original: How can it be?
passages.vernacular: 點可能?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼可能?

passages.original: O dainty duck! O dear!
passages.vernacular: 啊嬌嫩嘅鴨!啊親愛嘅!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊嬌嫩的鴨!啊親愛的!

passages.original: Thy mantle good, What, stained with blood?
passages.vernacular: 你嗰好斗篷,點,被血染喇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你那好斗篷,怎麼,被血染了?

passages.original: Approach, ye Furies fell!
passages.vernacular: 嚟吧,你哋兇猛嘅復仇女神!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來吧,你們兇猛的復仇女神!

passages.original: O Fates, come, come; Cut thread and thrum; Quail, rush, conclude, and quell!
passages.vernacular: 啊命運女神,嚟,嚟;剪斷線同線頭;壓倒、衝擊、結束、殺死!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊命運女神,來,來;剪斷線和線頭;壓倒、衝擊、結束、殺死!

passages.title: Theseus 忒修斯
passages.original: This passion, and the death of a dear friend, would go near to make a man look sad.
passages.vernacular: 呢種激情,同一位親愛朋友嘅死,足以使人睇起嚟悲傷。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這種激情,和一位親愛朋友的死,足以使人看起來悲傷。

passages.title: Hippolyta 希波呂忒
passages.original: Beshrew my heart, but I pity the man.
passages.vernacular: 該詛咒我嘅心,但我可憐呢個人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 該詛咒我的心,但我可憐這個人。

passages.title: Pyramus 皮拉姆斯
passages.original: O wherefore, Nature, didst thou lions frame, Since lion vile hath here deflower’d my dear?
passages.vernacular: 啊,自然,你點解造出獅子,既然可惡嘅獅子喺呢度玷污咗我嘅愛人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,自然,你為什麼造出獅子,既然可惡的獅子在這裡玷污了我的愛人?

passages.original: Which is—no, no—which was the fairest dame That liv’d, that lov’d, that lik’d, that look’d with cheer.
passages.vernacular: 佢係——不,不——佢曾係活過、愛過、鍾意過、笑臉相迎嘅最美嘅小姐。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她是——不,不——她曾是活過、愛過、喜歡過、笑臉相迎的最美的小姐。

passages.original: Come, tears, confound!
passages.vernacular: 嚟吧,眼淚,摧毀!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來吧,眼淚,摧毀!

passages.original: Out, sword, and wound The pap of Pyramus; Ay, that left pap, Where heart doth hop:
passages.vernacular: 出鞘吧,劍,刺傷皮拉姆斯嘅乳:對,嗰左邊嘅乳,嗰度心喺跳:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 出鞘吧,劍,刺傷皮拉姆斯的乳:對,那左邊的乳,那裡心在跳:

passages.original: Thus die I, thus, thus, thus.
passages.vernacular: 我就咁樣死,咁樣,咁樣,咁樣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我就這樣死,這樣,這樣,這樣。

passages.original: Now am I dead, Now am I fled; My soul is in the sky.
passages.vernacular: 而家我死喇,而家我逃喇;我嘅靈魂喺天上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在我死了,現在我逃了;我的靈魂在天上。

passages.original: Tongue, lose thy light!
passages.vernacular: 舌頭,失去你嘅光!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 舌頭,失去你的光!

passages.original: Moon, take thy flight!
passages.vernacular: 月亮,飛走吧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 月亮,飛走吧!

passages.original: Now die, die, die, die, die.
passages.vernacular: 而家死,死,死,死,死。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在死,死,死,死,死。

passages.original: [Dies. Exit Moonshine.]
passages.vernacular: [死。月光下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [死。月光下。]

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: No die, but an ace, for him; for he is but one.
passages.vernacular: 唔係死,係啲,對佢來講;因為佢只有一個。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不是死,是一點,對他來說;因為他只有一個。

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: Less than an ace, man; for he is dead, he is nothing.
passages.vernacular: 比啲仲少,老兄;因為佢死喇,佢乜嘢都唔係。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 比一點還少,老兄;因為他死了,他什麼都不是。

passages.title: Theseus 忒修斯
passages.original: With the help of a surgeon he might yet recover and prove an ass.
passages.vernacular: 藉外科醫生嘅幫助,佢或者仲能復原,證明係頭驢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 藉外科醫生的幫助,他也許還能復原,證明是頭驢。

passages.title: Hippolyta 希波呂忒
passages.original: How chance Moonshine is gone before Thisbe comes back and finds her lover?
passages.vernacular: 點月光喺提斯柏回嚟發現佢愛人之前就走喇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼月光在提斯柏回來發現她愛人之前就走了?

passages.title: Theseus 忒修斯
passages.original: She will find him by starlight.
passages.vernacular: 佢會借星光找到佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她會借星光找到他。

passages.original: Enter Thisbe.
passages.vernacular: [提斯柏上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [提斯柏上。]

passages.title: Theseus 忒修斯
passages.original: Here she comes, and her passion ends the play.
passages.vernacular: 佢嚟喇,佢嘅激情要結束呢齣戲喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她來了,她的激情要結束這齣戲了。

passages.title: Hippolyta 希波呂忒
passages.original: Methinks she should not use a long one for such a Pyramus.
passages.vernacular: 我想佢不該為咁樣嘅皮拉姆斯用長篇大論。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我想她不該為這樣的皮拉姆斯用長篇大論。

passages.original: I hope she will be brief.
passages.vernacular: 我希望佢簡短些。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我希望她簡短些。

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: A mote will turn the balance, which Pyramus, which Thisbe, is the better:
passages.vernacular: 一粒微塵就能使天平傾斜,睇邊個更好,皮拉姆斯,定係提斯柏:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一粒微塵就能使天平傾斜,看哪個更好,皮拉姆斯,還是提斯柏:

passages.original: he for a man, God warrant us; she for a woman, God bless us!
passages.vernacular: 佢作為男人,上帝保證我哋;佢作為女人,上帝保佑我哋!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他作為男人,上帝保證我們;她作為女人,上帝保佑我們!

passages.title: Lysander 拉山德
passages.original: She hath spied him already with those sweet eyes.
passages.vernacular: 佢已經用嗰雙甜美嘅眼睛睇到佢喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她已經用那雙甜美的眼睛看到他了。

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: And thus she means, videlicet—
passages.vernacular: 佢於是咁樣表達,即——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她於是這樣表達,即——

passages.title: Thisbe 提斯柏
passages.original: Asleep, my love?
passages.vernacular: 瞓住喇,我嘅愛?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 睡著了,我的愛?

passages.original: What, dead, my dove?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,死喇,我嘅鴿子?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,死了,我的鴿子?

passages.original: O Pyramus, arise, Speak, speak. Quite dumb? Dead, dead?
passages.vernacular: 啊皮拉姆斯,起嚟,講,講。完全啞喇?死喇,死喇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊皮拉姆斯,起來,說,說。完全啞了?死了,死了?

passages.original: A tomb Must cover thy sweet eyes.
passages.vernacular: 一座墳墓必須蓋住你甜美嘅眼睛。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一座墳墓必須蓋住你甜美的眼睛。

passages.original: These lily lips, This cherry nose, These yellow cowslip cheeks, Are gone, are gone!
passages.vernacular: 呢啲百合般嘅嘴唇,呢櫻桃般嘅鼻子,呢黃色報春花般嘅臉頰,都冇喇,都冇喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這些百合般的嘴唇,這櫻桃般的鼻子,這黃色報春花般的臉頰,都沒了,都沒了!

passages.original: Lovers, make moan; His eyes were green as leeks.
passages.vernacular: 戀人哋,哀悼吧;佢嘅眼睛綠得像韭菜。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 戀人們,哀悼吧;他的眼睛綠得像韭菜。

passages.original: O Sisters Three, Come, come to me, With hands as pale as milk;
passages.vernacular: 啊三姊妹,嚟,嚟到我身邊,帶住像牛奶一樣蒼白嘅手;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊三姊妹,來,來到我身邊,帶著像牛奶一樣蒼白的手;

passages.original: Lay them in gore, Since you have shore With shears his thread of silk.
passages.vernacular: 把佢哋浸入血中,既然你哋已用剪刀剪斷咗佢絲線般嘅線。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把它們浸入血中,既然你們已用剪刀剪斷了他絲線般的線。

passages.original: Tongue, not a word: Come, trusty sword, Come, blade, my breast imbrue; And farewell, friends.
passages.vernacular: 舌頭,唔好講話:嚟,忠實嘅劍,嚟,劍刃,染我嘅胸;再會,朋友哋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 舌頭,別說話:來,忠實的劍,來,劍刃,染我的胸;再會,朋友們。

passages.original: Thus Thisbe ends.
passages.vernacular: 提斯柏就咁樣結束。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 提斯柏就這樣結束。

passages.original: Adieu, adieu, adieu.
passages.vernacular: 再會,再會,再會。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 再會,再會,再會。

passages.original: [Dies.]

passages.title: Theseus 忒修斯
passages.original: Moonshine and Lion are left to bury the dead.
passages.vernacular: 月光同獅子留下嚟埋葬死者。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 月光和獅子留下來埋葬死者。

passages.title: Demetrius 狄米特律斯
passages.original: Ay, and Wall too.
passages.vernacular: 對,仲有牆。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對,還有牆。

passages.title: Bottom 波頓
passages.original: No, I assure you; the wall is down that parted their fathers.
passages.vernacular: 不,我向你保證;拆散佢哋父親嘅牆已經倒喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,我向你保證;拆散他們父親的牆已經倒了。

passages.original: Will it please you to see the epilogue, or to hear a Bergomask dance between two of our company?
passages.vernacular: 你哋願意睇收場白,定係睇我哋劇團兩個人跳一支貝加馬舞?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們願意看收場白,還是看我們劇團兩個人跳一支貝加馬舞?

passages.title: Theseus 忒修斯
passages.original: No epilogue, I pray you; for your play needs no excuse.
passages.vernacular: 請唔好收場白;因為你哋嘅戲不需要藉口。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請不要收場白;因為你們的戲不需要藉口。

passages.original: Never excuse; for when the players are all dead there need none to be blamed.
passages.vernacular: 絕唔好藉口;因為當演員全都死喇,就冇人需要被責備。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 絕不要藉口;因為當演員全都死了,就沒人需要被責備。

passages.original: Marry, if he that writ it had played Pyramus, and hanged himself in Thisbe’s garter, it would have been a fine tragedy;
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,如果寫戲嘅人演皮拉姆斯,把自己吊喺提斯柏嘅襪帶上,嗰會係一齣好悲劇;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,如果寫戲的人演皮拉姆斯,把自己吊在提斯柏的襪帶上,那會是一齣好悲劇;

passages.original: and so it is, truly; and very notably discharged.
passages.vernacular: 咁樣講,佢確實係;而且演得好出色。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這樣說,它確實是;而且演得非常出色。

passages.original: But come, your Bergomask; let your epilogue alone.
passages.vernacular: 但嚟,你嘅貝加馬舞;收場白就免喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但來,你的貝加馬舞;收場白就免了。

passages.original: [Here a dance of Clowns.]
passages.vernacular: [此處小丑哋跳舞。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [此處小丑們跳舞。]

passages.title: Theseus 忒修斯
passages.original: The iron tongue of midnight hath told twelve.
passages.vernacular: 午夜嘅鐵舌已敲過十二下。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 午夜的鐵舌已敲過十二下。

passages.original: Lovers, to bed; ’tis almost fairy time.
passages.vernacular: 戀人哋,去瞓吧;快到仙子嘅時間喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 戀人們,去睡吧;快到仙子的時間了。

passages.original: I fear we shall outsleep the coming morn As much as we this night have overwatch’d.
passages.vernacular: 我怕我哋會瞓過來臨嘅清晨,正如今夜我哋熬夜過多。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我怕我們會睡過來臨的清晨,正如今夜我們熬夜過多。

passages.original: This palpable-gross play hath well beguil’d The heavy gait of night.
passages.vernacular: 呢齣明顯粗俗嘅戲好好地消磨咗夜晚沉重嘅步伐。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這齣明顯粗俗的戲很好地消磨了夜晚沉重的步伐。

passages.original: Sweet friends, to bed.
passages.vernacular: 親愛嘅朋友哋,去瞓吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 親愛的朋友們,去睡吧。

passages.original: A fortnight hold we this solemnity In nightly revels and new jollity.
passages.vernacular: 我哋要連續兩星期喺夜晚嘅狂歡同新嘅歡樂中舉行呢慶典。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們要連續兩星期在夜晚的狂歡和新的歡樂中舉行這慶典。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

passages.original: Enter Puck.
passages.vernacular: [帕克上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [帕克上。]

passages.title: Puck 帕克
passages.original: Now the hungry lion roars, And the wolf behowls the moon;
passages.vernacular: 而家飢餓嘅獅子咆哮,狼對月亮嚎叫;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在飢餓的獅子咆哮,狼對月亮嚎叫;

passages.original: Whilst the heavy ploughman snores, All with weary task fordone.
passages.vernacular: 沉重嘅農夫打鼾,為疲憊嘅勞作所累。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沉重的農夫打鼾,為疲憊的勞作所累。

passages.original: Now the wasted brands do glow, Whilst the screech-owl, screeching loud, Puts the wretch that lies in woe In remembrance of a shroud.
passages.vernacular: 而家燃盡嘅火把發光,同時尖叫嘅貓頭鷹大聲尖叫,使躺喺悲痛中嘅可憐人想起裹屍布。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在燃盡的火把發光,同時尖叫的貓頭鷹大聲尖叫,使躺在悲痛中的可憐人想起裹屍布。

passages.original: Now it is the time of night That the graves, all gaping wide, Every one lets forth his sprite, In the church-way paths to glide.
passages.vernacular: 而家係夜裡咁樣嘅時辰,墳墓全都大張住口,每一座都放出佢嘅幽靈,喺教堂小路上滑行。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在是夜裡這樣的時辰,墳墓全都大張著口,每一座都放出它的幽靈,在教堂小路上滑行。

passages.original: And we fairies, that do run By the triple Hecate’s team From the presence of the sun, Following darkness like a dream, Now are frolic;
passages.vernacular: 而我哋仙子,隨三重赫卡忒嘅馬車奔跑,離開太陽嘅面前,像夢一樣追隨黑暗,而家歡鬧;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 而我們仙子,隨三重赫卡忒的馬車奔跑,離開太陽的面前,像夢一樣追隨黑暗,現在歡鬧;

passages.original: not a mouse Shall disturb this hallow’d house.
passages.vernacular: 一隻老鼠都唔會打擾呢神聖嘅家。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一隻老鼠也不會打擾這神聖的家。

passages.original: I am sent with broom before, To sweep the dust behind the door.
passages.vernacular: 我先被派嚟帶住掃帚,把門後嘅灰塵掃乾淨。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我先被派來帶著掃帚,把門後的灰塵掃乾淨。

passages.original: Enter Oberon and Titania with their Train.
passages.vernacular: [奧布朗同蒂塔妮婭偕隨從上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧布朗與蒂塔妮婭偕隨從上。]

passages.title: Oberon 奧布朗
passages.original: Through the house give glimmering light, By the dead and drowsy fire.
passages.vernacular: 穿過全屋畀出閃爍嘅光,借住將死、昏沉嘅火。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 穿過全屋給出閃爍的光,借著將死、昏沉的火。

passages.original: Every elf and fairy sprite Hop as light as bird from brier, And this ditty after me, Sing and dance it trippingly.
passages.vernacular: 每個小精靈同仙子,像鳥兒跳出荊棘般輕巧地跳躍,跟住我呢首小曲,輕快地唱同跳。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 每個小精靈和仙子,像鳥兒跳出荊棘般輕巧地跳躍,跟著我這首小曲,輕快地唱和跳。

passages.title: Titania 蒂塔妮婭
passages.original: First rehearse your song by rote, To each word a warbling note;
passages.vernacular: 首先背熟你哋嘅歌,每個字配一個婉轉嘅音符;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 首先背熟你們的歌,每個字配一個婉轉的音符;

passages.original: Hand in hand, with fairy grace, Will we sing, and bless this place.
passages.vernacular: 手牽手,帶住仙子嘅優雅,我哋要唱歌,祝福呢個地方。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 手牽手,帶著仙子的優雅,我們要唱歌,祝福這個地方。

passages.original: [Song and Dance.]
passages.vernacular: [歌同舞。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [歌與舞。]

passages.title: Oberon 奧布朗
passages.original: Now, until the break of day, Through this house each fairy stray.
passages.vernacular: 而家,直到天亮,每個仙子喺呢屋裡遊蕩。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在,直到天亮,每個仙子在這屋裡遊蕩。

passages.original: To the best bride-bed will we, Which by us shall blessèd be;
passages.vernacular: 我哋要去最好嘅新房,佢將因我哋而蒙福;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們要去最好的新房,它將因我們而蒙福;

passages.original: And the issue there create Ever shall be fortunate.
passages.vernacular: 喺嗰度創造嘅子女將永遠幸運。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在那裡創造的子女將永遠幸運。

passages.original: So shall all the couples three Ever true in loving be;
passages.vernacular: 咁樣三對夫妻將永遠相愛忠實;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這樣三對夫妻將永遠相愛忠實;

passages.original: And the blots of Nature’s hand Shall not in their issue stand:
passages.vernacular: 自然之手嘅缺點唔會留喺佢哋嘅子女身上:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 自然之手的缺點不會留在他們的子女身上:

passages.original: Never mole, hare-lip, nor scar, Nor mark prodigious, such as are Despised in nativity, Shall upon their children be.
passages.vernacular: 絕唔會有痣、兔唇、疤痕,或像嗰啲出生時被鄙視嘅怪異記號,出而家佢哋嘅細路身上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 絕不會有痣、兔唇、疤痕,或像那些出生時被鄙視的怪異記號,出現在他們的孩子身上。

passages.original: With this field-dew consecrate, Every fairy take his gait, And each several chamber bless, Through this palace, with sweet peace;
passages.vernacular: 用呢田野嘅露水祝聖,每個仙子取佢嘅路,祝福每個房間,喺呢宮殿中,以甜美嘅平安;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 用這田野的露水祝聖,每個仙子取他的路,祝福每個房間,在這宮殿中,以甜美的平安;

passages.original: And the owner of it blest.
passages.vernacular: 並祝福佢嘅主人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 並祝福它的主人。

passages.original: Ever shall it in safety rest, Trip away.
passages.vernacular: 佢將永遠安全地休憩,快走。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它將永遠安全地休憩,快走。

passages.original: Make no stay; Meet me all by break of day.
passages.vernacular: 唔好停留;天亮前都嚟見我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不要停留;天亮前都來見我。

passages.original: [Exeunt Oberon, Titania and Train.]
passages.vernacular: [奧布朗、蒂塔妮婭同隨從下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧布朗、蒂塔妮婭與隨從下。]

passages.title: Puck 帕克
passages.original: If we shadows have offended, Think but this, and all is mended, That you have but slumber’d here While these visions did appear.
passages.vernacular: 如果我哋呢啲影子冒犯咗你哋,只要咁樣想,一切就彌補喇:你哋不過喺呢度打咗個盹,而呢啲幻象出現過。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果我們這些影子冒犯了你們,只要這樣想,一切就彌補了:你們不過在這裡打了個盹,而這些幻象出現過。

passages.original: And this weak and idle theme, No more yielding but a dream, Gentles, do not reprehend.
passages.vernacular: 而呢薄弱、空閒嘅主題,不過係個夢,諸位,請別責備。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 而這薄弱、空閒的主題,不過是個夢,諸位,請別責備。

passages.original: If you pardon, we will mend.
passages.vernacular: 如果你哋原諒,我哋會改進。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你們原諒,我們會改進。

passages.original: And, as I am an honest Puck, If we have unearnèd luck Now to ’scape the serpent’s tongue, We will make amends ere long;
passages.vernacular: 而且,我以誠實嘅帕克起誓,如果我哋而家不勞而獲地逃過蛇嘅舌頭,我哋不久會作出補償;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 而且,我以誠實的帕克起誓,如果我們現在不勞而獲地逃過蛇的舌頭,我們不久會作出補償;

passages.original: Else the Puck a liar call.
passages.vernacular: 否則就叫帕克騙子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 否則就叫帕克騙子。

passages.original: So, good night unto you all.
passages.vernacular: 咁,晚安,諸位。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼,晚安,諸位。

passages.original: Give me your hands, if we be friends, And Robin shall restore amends.
passages.vernacular: 如果我哋係朋友,就畀我你哋嘅手,羅賓就會償還補償。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果我們是朋友,就給我你們的手,羅賓就會償還補償。

passages.original: [Exit.]
